      = ∫ y, (∫ x in A, (f : E → ℝ) (x - y)) ∂μ := by
    rw [← integral_indicator hA]
    have hswap : ∫ x, A.indicator (mconvE μ (f : E → ℝ)) x
        = ∫ x, ∫ y, A.indicator (fun x' => (f : E → ℝ) (x' - y)) x ∂μ := by
      refine integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => ?_)
      by_cases hx : x ∈ A
      · simp only [Set.indicator_of_mem hx, mconvE_apply]
      · simp only [Set.indicator_of_notMem hx, integral_zero]
    rw [hswap, integral_integral_swap hprodint]
    refine integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => ?_)
    change ∫ x, A.indicator (fun x' => (f : E → ℝ) (x' - y)) x
      = ∫ x in A, (f : E → ℝ) (x - y)
    rw [integral_indicator hA]
  rw [hleft, hright]

name: ScaleSpace.apply_mconvL1E_general
statement:
theorem apply_mconvL1E_general (Ψ : (E →₁[volume] ℝ) →L[ℝ] F) (μ : Measure E) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (f : E →₁[volume] ℝ) :
    Ψ (mconvL1E μ f) = ∫ y, Ψ (transL1E y f) ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [← bconvME_eq_mconvL1E, bconvME,
    ← ContinuousLinearMap.integral_comp_comm _ (integrable_transL1E μ f)]

name: ScaleSpace.pairTransE_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma pairTransE_apply (Ψ : (E →₁[volume] ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (f : E →₁[volume] ℝ) (y : E) :
    pairTransE Ψ f y = Ψ (transL1E y f)
proof: := rfl

name: ScaleSpace.apply_mconvL1E
statement:
theorem apply_mconvL1E (Ψ : (E →₁[volume] ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (μ : Measure E) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (f : E →₁[volume] ℝ) :
    Ψ (mconvL1E μ f) = ∫ y, pairTransE Ψ f y ∂μ
proof:
:=
  apply_mconvL1E_general Ψ μ f

name: ScaleSpace.apply_bconvE
statement:
theorem apply_bconvE (Ψ : (E →₁[volume] ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) {g : E → ℝ} (hg : Integrable g)
    (f : E →₁[volume] ℝ) :
    Ψ (bconvE g f) = ∫ y, g y * pairTransE Ψ f y
proof:
:= by
  rw [bconvE, ← ContinuousLinearMap.integral_comp_comm _ (integrable_smul_transL1E hg f)]
  refine integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => ?_)
  change Ψ (g y • transL1E y f) = g y * Ψ (transL1E y f)
  rw [ContinuousLinearMap.map_smul, smul_eq_mul]

name: ScaleSpace.eq_dirac_of_mconvL1E_eq_id
statement:
theorem eq_dirac_of_mconvL1E_eq_id {μ : Measure E} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (h : mconvL1E μ = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (E →₁[volume] ℝ)) : μ = Measure.dirac 0
proof:
:= by
  set k : E → ℝ := fun y => max 0 (1 - ‖y‖) with hk
  have hkc : Continuous k := continuous_const.max (continuous_const.sub continuous_norm)
  have hk0 : k 0 = 1 := by simp [hk]
  have hkb : ∀ y, k y ≤ 1 := fun y =>
    max_le zero_le_one (by linarith [norm_nonneg y])
  have hkn : ∀ y, 0 ≤ k y := fun y => le_max_left _ _
  have hklt : ∀ y : E, y ≠ 0 → k y < 1 := fun y hy =>
    max_lt zero_lt_one (by linarith [norm_pos_iff.mpr hy])
  have hksupp : HasCompactSupport k := by
    refine HasCompactSupport.intro (isCompact_closedBall (0 : E) 1) fun y hy => ?_
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, not_le] at hy
    exact max_eq_left (by linarith)
  have hki : Integrable k := hkc.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hksupp
  have hkiμ : Integrable k μ :=
    (integrable_const (1 : ℝ)).mono' hkc.aestronglyMeasurable
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => by
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hkn y)]; exact hkb y)
  have hae : mconvE μ k =ᵐ[volume] k := by
    have h1 : ((mconvL1E μ (hki.toL1 k) : E →₁[volume] ℝ) : E → ℝ) =ᵐ[volume] mconvE μ k :=
      (coeFn_mconvL1E μ _).trans (mconvE_congr_ae μ (Integrable.coeFn_toL1 hki))
    have h2 : ((mconvL1E μ (hki.toL1 k) : E →₁[volume] ℝ) : E → ℝ) =ᵐ[volume] k := by
      rw [h]; simpa using Integrable.coeFn_toL1 hki
    exact h1.symm.trans h2
  have hcont : Continuous (mconvE μ k) := by
    refine continuous_of_dominated (bound := fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) ?_ ?_ (integrable_const _) ?_
    · exact fun x => (hkc.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id)).aestronglyMeasurable
    · exact fun x => Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => by
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hkn _)]
        exact hkb _
    · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => hkc.comp (continuous_id.sub continuous_const)
  have heq : mconvE μ k = k := (hcont.ae_eq_iff_eq volume hkc).mp hae
  have hint : ∫ y, k y ∂μ = 1 := by
    have h0 : mconvE μ k 0 = k 0 := by rw [heq]
    rw [mconvE_apply, hk0] at h0
    have hsimp : ∫ y, k (0 - y) ∂μ = ∫ y, k y ∂μ := by
      refine integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => ?_)
      simp [hk]
    rw [hsimp] at h0
    exact h0
  have hzero : ∀ᵐ y ∂μ, (1 : ℝ) - k y = 0 := by
    refine (integral_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun y => sub_nonneg.mpr (hkb y))
      ((integrable_const (1 : ℝ)).sub hkiμ)).mp ?_
    rw [integral_sub (integrable_const _) hkiμ, integral_const, hint]
    simp
  have hae0 : ∀ᵐ y ∂μ, y = 0 := by
    filter_upwards [hzero] with y hy
    by_contra hne
    have hlt := hklt y hne
    linarith [sub_eq_zero.mp hy]
  have hnull : μ {y | y ≠ 0} = 0 := ae_iff.mp hae0
  ext s hs
  rw [Measure.dirac_apply' _ hs]
  by_cases h0 : (0 : E) ∈ s
  · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem h0, Pi.one_apply]
    refine (prob_compl_eq_zero_iff hs).mp (measure_mono_null (fun y hy => ?_) hnull)
    rintro rfl
    exact hy h0
  · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem h0]
    refine measure_mono_null (fun y hy => ?_) hnull
    rintro rfl
    exact h0 hy

name: ScaleSpace.bconvE_real
statement: theorem bconvE_real (f : ℝ → ℝ) (g : X) : bconvE f g = bconv f g
proof:
:= by
  simp only [bconvE, bconv, transL1E_real]

name: ScaleSpace.bconvME_real
statement: theorem bconvME_real (μ : Measure ℝ) (f : X) : bconvME μ f = bconvM μ f
proof:
:= by
  simp only [bconvME, bconvM, transL1E_real]

name: ScaleSpace.fourierSin_apply
statement:
lemma fourierSin_apply (μ : Measure ℝ) (ω : ℝ) :
    fourierSin μ ω = ∫ x, Real.sin (ω * x) ∂μ
proof: := rfl

name: ScaleSpace.charFun_eq
statement:
theorem charFun_eq (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (ω : ℝ) :
    charFun μ ω = ((fourierCos μ ω : ℝ) : ℂ) + Complex.I * ((fourierSin μ ω : ℝ) : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [charFun_apply_real]
  have hpt : ∀ x : ℝ, Complex.exp ((ω : ℂ) * (x : ℂ) * Complex.I)
      = ((Real.cos (ω * x) : ℂ)) + Complex.I * ((Real.sin (ω * x) : ℂ)) := by
    intro x
    have hcast : (ω : ℂ) * (x : ℂ) = ((ω * x : ℝ) : ℂ) := by push_cast; ring
    rw [hcast, Complex.exp_mul_I, Complex.ofReal_cos, Complex.ofReal_sin]
    ring
  simp only [hpt]
  rw [integral_add, integral_complex_ofReal, integral_const_mul, integral_complex_ofReal]
  · rfl
  · exact (integrable_cos_mul μ ω).ofReal
  · exact ((integrable_sin_mul μ ω).ofReal).const_mul _

name: ScaleSpace.integral_odd_eq_zero
statement: lemma integral_odd_eq_zero {g : ℝ → ℝ} (hodd : ∀ x, g (-x) = -g x) : ∫ x, g x = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ∫ x, g (-x) = ∫ x, g x := integral_neg_eq_self g volume
  simp only [hodd, integral_neg] at h1
  linarith

name: ScaleSpace.integrable_cos_mul_self
statement:
lemma integrable_cos_mul_self (hfi : Integrable f) (ω : ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun u => Real.cos (ω * u) * f u)
proof:
:= by
  refine hfi.bdd_mul (c := 1)
    ((Real.continuous_cos.comp (continuous_const.mul continuous_id)).aestronglyMeasurable) ?_
  exact ae_of_all _ fun u => by simpa using Real.abs_cos_le_one (ω * u)

name: ScaleSpace.integrable_sin_mul_self
statement:
lemma integrable_sin_mul_self (hfi : Integrable f) (ω : ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun u => Real.sin (ω * u) * f u)
proof:
:= by
  refine hfi.bdd_mul (c := 1)
    ((Real.continuous_sin.comp (continuous_const.mul continuous_id)).aestronglyMeasurable) ?_
  exact ae_of_all _ fun u => by simpa using Real.abs_sin_le_one (ω * u)

name: ScaleSpace.integral_sin_mul_eq_zero
statement:
lemma integral_sin_mul_eq_zero (heven : ∀ x, f (-x) = f x) (ω : ℝ) :
    ∫ u, Real.sin (ω * u) * f u = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine integral_odd_eq_zero fun x => ?_
  rw [heven, mul_neg, Real.sin_neg, neg_mul]

name: ScaleSpace.integral_cos_mul_translate
statement:
lemma integral_cos_mul_translate (hfi : Integrable f) (heven : ∀ x, f (-x) = f x) (ω r : ℝ) :
    ∫ t, Real.cos (ω * t) * f (t - r) = Real.cos (ω * r) * ∫ u, Real.cos (ω * u) * f u
proof:
:= by
  have hshift : ∫ t, Real.cos (ω * t) * f (t - r)
      = ∫ u, Real.cos (ω * (u + r)) * f u := by
    rw [← integral_add_right_eq_self (fun t => Real.cos (ω * t) * f (t - r)) r]
    simp
  rw [hshift]
  have hpt : ∀ u : ℝ, Real.cos (ω * (u + r)) * f u
      = Real.cos (ω * r) * (Real.cos (ω * u) * f u)
        - Real.sin (ω * r) * (Real.sin (ω * u) * f u) := by
    intro u
    rw [mul_add, Real.cos_add]
    ring
  simp only [hpt]
  rw [integral_sub ((integrable_cos_mul_self hfi ω).const_mul _)
      ((integrable_sin_mul_self hfi ω).const_mul _),
    integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul, integral_sin_mul_eq_zero heven, mul_zero, sub_zero]

name: ScaleSpace.integral_sin_mul_translate
statement:
lemma integral_sin_mul_translate (hfi : Integrable f) (heven : ∀ x, f (-x) = f x) (ω r : ℝ) :
    ∫ t, Real.sin (ω * t) * f (t - r) = Real.sin (ω * r) * ∫ u, Real.cos (ω * u) * f u
proof:
:= by
  have hshift : ∫ t, Real.sin (ω * t) * f (t - r)
      = ∫ u, Real.sin (ω * (u + r)) * f u := by
    rw [← integral_add_right_eq_self (fun t => Real.sin (ω * t) * f (t - r)) r]
    simp
  rw [hshift]
  have hpt : ∀ u : ℝ, Real.sin (ω * (u + r)) * f u
      = Real.sin (ω * r) * (Real.cos (ω * u) * f u)
        + Real.cos (ω * r) * (Real.sin (ω * u) * f u) := by
    intro u
    rw [mul_add, Real.sin_add]
    ring
  simp only [hpt]
  rw [integral_add ((integrable_cos_mul_self hfi ω).const_mul _)
      ((integrable_sin_mul_self hfi ω).const_mul _),
    integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul, integral_sin_mul_eq_zero heven, mul_zero, add_zero]

name: ScaleSpace.integral_cos_mul_mconv
statement:
theorem integral_cos_mul_mconv (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (hfi : Integrable f)
    (hfm : Measurable f) (heven : ∀ x, f (-x) = f x) (ω : ℝ) :
    ∫ t, Real.cos (ω * t) * mconv μ f t = (∫ u, Real.cos (ω * u) * f u) * fourierCos μ ω
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_mul_mconv (f := f) (g := fun t => Real.cos (ω * t)) μ
    hfm.aestronglyMeasurable hfi (by fun_prop) (C := 1) (fun t => Real.abs_cos_le_one _)]
  simp only [integral_cos_mul_translate hfi heven ω]
  rw [integral_mul_const, fourierCos_apply]
  ring

name: ScaleSpace.integral_sin_mul_mconv
statement:
theorem integral_sin_mul_mconv (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (hfi : Integrable f)
    (hfm : Measurable f) (heven : ∀ x, f (-x) = f x) (ω : ℝ) :
    ∫ t, Real.sin (ω * t) * mconv μ f t = (∫ u, Real.cos (ω * u) * f u) * fourierSin μ ω
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_mul_mconv (f := f) (g := fun t => Real.sin (ω * t)) μ
    hfm.aestronglyMeasurable hfi (by fun_prop) (C := 1) (fun t => Real.abs_sin_le_one _)]
  simp only [integral_sin_mul_translate hfi heven ω]
  rw [integral_mul_const, fourierSin_apply]
  ring

name: ScaleSpace.measurable_gaussTest
statement: lemma measurable_gaussTest : Measurable gaussTest
proof: := measurable_gaussianPDFReal 0 1

name: ScaleSpace.integrable_gaussTest
statement: lemma integrable_gaussTest : Integrable gaussTest
proof: := integrable_gaussianPDFReal 0 1

name: ScaleSpace.gaussTest_even
statement: lemma gaussTest_even (x : ℝ) : gaussTest (-x) = gaussTest x
proof:
:= by
  simp [gaussTest, gaussianPDFReal]

name: ScaleSpace.integral_cos_mul_gaussTest
statement:
theorem integral_cos_mul_gaussTest (ω : ℝ) :
    ∫ u, Real.cos (ω * u) * gaussTest u = Real.exp (-(ω ^ 2) / 2)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ∫ u, Real.cos (ω * u) * gaussTest u
      = ∫ u, Real.cos (ω * u) ∂(gaussianReal 0 1) := by
    rw [integral_gaussianReal_eq_integral_smul (by norm_num)]
    simp [gaussTest, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]
  rw [h1, ← fourierCos_apply, fourierCos_gaussianReal]
  norm_num
  ring

name: ScaleSpace.integral_cos_mul_gaussTest_pos
statement: theorem integral_cos_mul_gaussTest_pos (ω : ℝ) : 0 < ∫ u, Real.cos (ω * u) * gaussTest u
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_cos_mul_gaussTest]
  exact Real.exp_pos _

name: ScaleSpace.eq_of_mconv_gaussTest_ae
statement:
theorem eq_of_mconv_gaussTest_ae {μ ν : Measure ℝ} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    (h : mconv μ gaussTest =ᵐ[volume] mconv ν gaussTest) : μ = ν
proof:
:= by
  refine Measure.ext_of_charFun (funext fun ω => ?_)
  have hcosint : ∫ t, Real.cos (ω * t) * mconv μ gaussTest t
      = ∫ t, Real.cos (ω * t) * mconv ν gaussTest t := by
    refine integral_congr_ae ?_
    filter_upwards [h] with t ht
    rw [ht]
  have hsinint : ∫ t, Real.sin (ω * t) * mconv μ gaussTest t
      = ∫ t, Real.sin (ω * t) * mconv ν gaussTest t := by
    refine integral_congr_ae ?_
    filter_upwards [h] with t ht
    rw [ht]
  rw [integral_cos_mul_mconv μ integrable_gaussTest measurable_gaussTest gaussTest_even ω,
    integral_cos_mul_mconv ν integrable_gaussTest measurable_gaussTest gaussTest_even ω] at hcosint
  rw [integral_sin_mul_mconv μ integrable_gaussTest measurable_gaussTest gaussTest_even ω,
    integral_sin_mul_mconv ν integrable_gaussTest measurable_gaussTest gaussTest_even ω] at hsinint
  have hC := (integral_cos_mul_gaussTest_pos ω).ne'
  rw [charFun_eq, charFun_eq, mul_left_cancel₀ hC hcosint, mul_left_cancel₀ hC hsinint]

name: ScaleSpace.coeFn_gaussL1_gaussTest
statement: lemma coeFn_gaussL1_gaussTest : ((gaussL1 : X) : ℝ → ℝ) =ᵐ[volume] gaussTest
proof: := coeFn_gaussL1

name: ScaleSpace.isFiniteMeasure_convPow
statement:
theorem isFiniteMeasure_convPow (L : Measure ℝ) [IsFiniteMeasure L] (n : ℕ) :
    IsFiniteMeasure (convPow L n)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rw [convPow]; infer_instance
  | succ n ih => rw [convPow]; infer_instance

name: ScaleSpace.isProbabilityMeasure_convPow_real
statement:
theorem isProbabilityMeasure_convPow_real (L : Measure ℝ) [IsProbabilityMeasure L] (n : ℕ) :
    IsProbabilityMeasure (convPow L n)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rw [convPow]; infer_instance
  | succ n ih => haveI := ih; rw [convPow]; infer_instance

name: ScaleSpace.isFiniteMeasure_convPow_Rd
statement:
theorem isFiniteMeasure_convPow_Rd (L : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d))) [IsFiniteMeasure L]
    (n : ℕ) : IsFiniteMeasure (convPow L n)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rw [convPow]; infer_instance
  | succ n ih => rw [convPow]; infer_instance

name: ScaleSpace.measurePreserving_sub_constE
statement:
theorem measurePreserving_sub_constE (a : E) :
    MeasurePreserving (fun x : E => x - a) volume volume
proof:
:=
  measurePreserving_sub_right volume a

name: ScaleSpace.translate_congr_aeE
statement:
theorem translate_congr_aeE (a : E) {f g : E → ℝ} (h : f =ᵐ[volume] g) :
    (fun x => f (x - a)) =ᵐ[volume] fun x => g (x - a)
proof:
:=
  (measurePreserving_sub_constE a).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae h

name: ScaleSpace.integrable_translateE
statement:
theorem integrable_translateE {f : E → ℝ} (hf : Integrable f) (a : E) :
    Integrable (fun x => f (x - a))
proof:
:=
  ((measurePreserving_sub_constE a).integrable_comp hf.aestronglyMeasurable).mpr hf

name: ScaleSpace.coeFn_transL1E
statement:
lemma coeFn_transL1E (a : E) (f : E →₁[volume] ℝ) :
    transL1E a f =ᵐ[volume] fun x => (f : E → ℝ) (x - a)
proof:
:=
  Integrable.coeFn_toL1 (integrable_translateE (L1.integrable_coeFn f) a)

name: ScaleSpace.norm_transL1E_le
statement: lemma norm_transL1E_le (a : E) (f : E →₁[volume] ℝ) : ‖transL1E a f‖ ≤ ‖f‖
proof:
:= by
  have hop : ‖transL1E a‖ ≤ 1 := LinearMap.mkContinuous_norm_le _ zero_le_one _
  calc ‖transL1E a f‖ ≤ ‖transL1E a‖ * ‖f‖ := ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ _
    _ ≤ 1 * ‖f‖ := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg f]
    _ = ‖f‖ := one_mul _

name: ScaleSpace.eq_transL1E_iff
statement:
theorem eq_transL1E_iff (a : E) (f g : E →₁[volume] ℝ) :
    g = transL1E a f ↔ (g : E → ℝ) =ᵐ[volume] fun x => (f : E → ℝ) (x - a)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro rfl
    exact coeFn_transL1E a f
  · intro h
    exact Lp.ext (h.trans (coeFn_transL1E a f).symm)

name: ScaleSpace.transL1E_zero
statement: theorem transL1E_zero : transL1E (0 : E) = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (E →₁[volume] ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun f => Lp.ext ?_
  refine (coeFn_transL1E 0 f).trans ?_
  simp only [sub_zero]
  rfl

name: ScaleSpace.transL1E_comp
statement:
theorem transL1E_comp (a b : E) :
    (transL1E a).comp (transL1E b) = transL1E (a + b)
proof:
:= by
  refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun f => Lp.ext ?_
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply]
  refine (coeFn_transL1E a _).trans ?_
  refine (translate_congr_aeE a (coeFn_transL1E b f)).trans ?_
  refine Filter.EventuallyEq.trans ?_ (coeFn_transL1E (a + b) f).symm
  filter_upwards with x
  rw [sub_sub]

name: ScaleSpace.isNonnegE_transL1E
statement:
theorem isNonnegE_transL1E (a : E) {f : E →₁[volume] ℝ} (hf : IsNonnegE f) :
    IsNonnegE (transL1E a f)
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [coeFn_transL1E a f,
    (measurePreserving_sub_constE a).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae hf] with x hx hfx
  simp only [Pi.zero_apply] at hfx ⊢
  rw [hx]
  exact hfx

name: ScaleSpace.det_ne_zeroE
statement: theorem det_ne_zeroE (A : E ≃L[ℝ] E) : LinearMap.det (A : E →ₗ[ℝ] E) ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  (LinearEquiv.isUnit_det' A.toLinearEquiv).ne_zero

name: ScaleSpace.dilateE_apply
statement:
lemma dilateE_apply (A : E ≃L[ℝ] E) (f : E → ℝ) (x : E) :
    dilateE A f x = |LinearMap.det (A : E →ₗ[ℝ] E)|⁻¹ * f (A.symm x)
proof: := rfl

name: ScaleSpace.homothety_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma homothety_apply [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (lam : ℝ) (hlam : lam ≠ 0) (x : E) :
    homothety lam hlam x = lam • x
proof: := rfl

name: ScaleSpace.homothety_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma homothety_symm_apply [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (lam : ℝ) (hlam : lam ≠ 0) (x : E) :
    (homothety lam hlam).symm x = lam⁻¹ • x
proof: := rfl

name: ScaleSpace.det_homothety
statement:
lemma det_homothety [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (lam : ℝ) (hlam : lam ≠ 0) :
    LinearMap.det ((homothety lam hlam : E ≃L[ℝ] E) : E →ₗ[ℝ] E)
      = lam ^ Module.finrank ℝ E
proof:
:= by
  have h : ((homothety lam hlam : E ≃L[ℝ] E) : E →ₗ[ℝ] E) = lam • LinearMap.id := by
    ext x
    rfl
  rw [h, LinearMap.det_smul, LinearMap.det_id, mul_one]

name: ScaleSpace.abs_det_neg
statement:
lemma abs_det_neg [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] :
    |LinearMap.det ((ContinuousLinearEquiv.neg ℝ : E ≃L[ℝ] E) : E →ₗ[ℝ] E)| = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h : ((ContinuousLinearEquiv.neg ℝ : E ≃L[ℝ] E) : E →ₗ[ℝ] E)
      = (-1 : ℝ) • LinearMap.id := by
    ext x
    simp
  rw [h, LinearMap.det_smul, LinearMap.det_id, mul_one, abs_pow, abs_neg, abs_one, one_pow]

name: ScaleSpace.det_refl
statement:
lemma det_refl :
    LinearMap.det ((ContinuousLinearEquiv.refl ℝ E : E ≃L[ℝ] E) : E →ₗ[ℝ] E) = 1
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.det_id

name: ScaleSpace.map_symm_volumeE
statement:
theorem map_symm_volumeE (A : E ≃L[ℝ] E) :
    Measure.map A.symm volume = ENNReal.ofReal |LinearMap.det (A : E →ₗ[ℝ] E)| • volume
proof:
:= by
  ext s hs
  rw [Measure.map_apply A.symm.continuous.measurable hs,
    Measure.addHaar_preimage_continuousLinearEquiv, ContinuousLinearEquiv.symm_symm]
  rfl

name: ScaleSpace.quasiMeasurePreserving_symmE
statement:
theorem quasiMeasurePreserving_symmE (A : E ≃L[ℝ] E) :
    Measure.QuasiMeasurePreserving A.symm volume volume
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨A.symm.continuous.measurable, ?_⟩
  rw [map_symm_volumeE]
  exact Measure.smul_absolutelyContinuous

name: ScaleSpace.lintegral_comp_symmE
statement:
theorem lintegral_comp_symmE (A : E ≃L[ℝ] E) (g : E → ℝ≥0∞) :
    ∫⁻ x, g (A.symm x) = ENNReal.ofReal |LinearMap.det (A : E →ₗ[ℝ] E)| * ∫⁻ x, g x
proof:
:= by
  have he : MeasurableEmbedding (A.symm : E → E) := A.symm.toHomeomorph.measurableEmbedding
  rw [← smul_eq_mul, ← lintegral_smul_measure, ← map_symm_volumeE, he.lintegral_map]

name: ScaleSpace.dilateE_congr_ae
statement:
theorem dilateE_congr_ae (A : E ≃L[ℝ] E) {f g : E → ℝ} (h : f =ᵐ[volume] g) :
    dilateE A f =ᵐ[volume] dilateE A g
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [(quasiMeasurePreserving_symmE A).ae h] with x hx
  simp only [dilateE, hx]

name: ScaleSpace.integrable_dilateE
statement:
theorem integrable_dilateE (A : E ≃L[ℝ] E) {f : E → ℝ} (hf : Integrable f) :
    Integrable (dilateE A f)
proof:
:= by
  have hm : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => f (A.symm x)) volume :=
    hf.aestronglyMeasurable.comp_quasiMeasurePreserving (quasiMeasurePreserving_symmE A)
  have hi : Integrable (fun x => f (A.symm x)) := by
    refine ⟨hm, ?_⟩
    rw [hasFiniteIntegral_iff_enorm, lintegral_comp_symmE A (fun x => ‖f x‖ₑ)]
    exact ENNReal.mul_lt_top ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top hf.2
  exact hi.const_mul _

name: ScaleSpace.lintegral_enorm_dilateE
statement:
theorem lintegral_enorm_dilateE (A : E ≃L[ℝ] E) (f : E → ℝ) :
    ∫⁻ x, ‖dilateE A f x‖ₑ = ∫⁻ x, ‖f x‖ₑ
proof:
:= by
  have hdet : 0 < |LinearMap.det (A : E →ₗ[ℝ] E)| := abs_pos.mpr (det_ne_zeroE A)
  have henorm : ∀ x, ‖dilateE A f x‖ₑ
      = ENNReal.ofReal |LinearMap.det (A : E →ₗ[ℝ] E)|⁻¹ * ‖f (A.symm x)‖ₑ := by
    intro x
    simp only [dilateE, enorm_mul, Real.enorm_eq_ofReal (inv_nonneg.mpr hdet.le)]
  simp only [henorm]
  rw [lintegral_const_mul' _ _ ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top, lintegral_comp_symmE A (fun x => ‖f x‖ₑ),
    ← mul_assoc, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (inv_nonneg.mpr hdet.le), inv_mul_cancel₀ hdet.ne',
    ENNReal.ofReal_one, one_mul]

name: ScaleSpace.coeFn_dilL1E
statement:
lemma coeFn_dilL1E (A : E ≃L[ℝ] E) (f : E →₁[volume] ℝ) :
    dilL1E A f =ᵐ[volume] dilateE A (f : E → ℝ)
proof:
:=
  Integrable.coeFn_toL1 (integrable_dilateE A (L1.integrable_coeFn f))

name: ScaleSpace.eq_dilL1E_iff
statement:
theorem eq_dilL1E_iff (A : E ≃L[ℝ] E) (f g : E →₁[volume] ℝ) :
    g = dilL1E A f ↔ (g : E → ℝ) =ᵐ[volume]
      fun x => |LinearMap.det (A : E →ₗ[ℝ] E)|⁻¹ * (f : E → ℝ) (A.symm x)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro rfl
    exact coeFn_dilL1E A f
  · intro h
    exact Lp.ext (h.trans (coeFn_dilL1E A f).symm)

name: ScaleSpace.norm_dilL1E
statement: theorem norm_dilL1E (A : E ≃L[ℝ] E) (f : E →₁[volume] ℝ) : ‖dilL1E A f‖ = ‖f‖
proof:
:= by
  have h : ∫⁻ x, ‖(dilL1E A f : E → ℝ) x‖ₑ = ∫⁻ x, ‖dilateE A (f : E → ℝ) x‖ₑ := by
    refine lintegral_congr_ae ?_
    filter_upwards [coeFn_dilL1E A f] with x hx
    rw [hx]
  rw [Lp.norm_def, eLpNorm_one_eq_lintegral_enorm, Lp.norm_def, eLpNorm_one_eq_lintegral_enorm,
    h, lintegral_enorm_dilateE]

name: ScaleSpace.dilL1E_refl
statement:
theorem dilL1E_refl :
    dilL1E (ContinuousLinearEquiv.refl ℝ E) = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (E →₁[volume] ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun f => Lp.ext ?_
  refine (coeFn_dilL1E _ f).trans ?_
  filter_upwards with x
  rw [dilateE_apply, det_refl, abs_one, inv_one, one_mul]
  rfl

name: ScaleSpace.dilL1E_comp
statement:
theorem dilL1E_comp (A B : E ≃L[ℝ] E) :
    (dilL1E A).comp (dilL1E B) = dilL1E (B.trans A)
proof:
:= by
  refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun f => Lp.ext ?_
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply]
  refine (coeFn_dilL1E A _).trans ?_
  refine (dilateE_congr_ae A (coeFn_dilL1E B f)).trans ?_
  refine Filter.EventuallyEq.trans ?_ (coeFn_dilL1E (B.trans A) f).symm
  filter_upwards with x
  have hdet : LinearMap.det ((B.trans A : E ≃L[ℝ] E) : E →ₗ[ℝ] E)
      = LinearMap.det (A : E →ₗ[ℝ] E) * LinearMap.det (B : E →ₗ[ℝ] E) := by
    rw [← LinearMap.det_comp]
    rfl
  simp only [dilateE, hdet, abs_mul, mul_inv, ContinuousLinearEquiv.symm_trans_apply]
  ring

name: ScaleSpace.dilL1E_symm_comp
statement:
theorem dilL1E_symm_comp (A : E ≃L[ℝ] E) :
    (dilL1E A.symm).comp (dilL1E A) = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (E →₁[volume] ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [dilL1E_comp, ContinuousLinearEquiv.self_trans_symm, dilL1E_refl]

name: ScaleSpace.dilL1E_comp_symm
statement:
theorem dilL1E_comp_symm (A : E ≃L[ℝ] E) :
    (dilL1E A).comp (dilL1E A.symm) = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (E →₁[volume] ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [dilL1E_comp, ContinuousLinearEquiv.symm_trans_self, dilL1E_refl]

name: ScaleSpace.dilL1EEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma dilL1EEquiv_apply (A : E ≃L[ℝ] E) (f : E →₁[volume] ℝ) :
    dilL1EEquiv A f = dilL1E A f
proof: := rfl

name: ScaleSpace.dilL1EEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma dilL1EEquiv_symm_apply (A : E ≃L[ℝ] E) (f : E →₁[volume] ℝ) :
    (dilL1EEquiv A).symm f = dilL1E A.symm f
proof: := rfl

name: ScaleSpace.dilL1E_comp_transL1E
statement:
theorem dilL1E_comp_transL1E (A : E ≃L[ℝ] E) (a : E) :
    (dilL1E A).comp (transL1E a) = (transL1E (A a)).comp (dilL1E A)
proof:
:= by
  refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun f => Lp.ext ?_
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply]
  refine ((coeFn_dilL1E A _).trans (dilateE_congr_ae A (coeFn_transL1E a f))).trans ?_
  refine Filter.EventuallyEq.symm ?_
  refine ((coeFn_transL1E (A a) _).trans (translate_congr_aeE (A a) (coeFn_dilL1E A f))).trans ?_
  filter_upwards with x
  simp only [dilateE, map_sub, ContinuousLinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: ScaleSpace.isNonnegE_dilL1E
statement:
theorem isNonnegE_dilL1E (A : E ≃L[ℝ] E) {f : E →₁[volume] ℝ} (hf : IsNonnegE f) :
    IsNonnegE (dilL1E A f)
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [coeFn_dilL1E A f, (quasiMeasurePreserving_symmE A).ae hf] with x hx hfx
  simp only [Pi.zero_apply] at hfx ⊢
  rw [hx, dilateE_apply]
  exact mul_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr (abs_nonneg _)) hfx

name: ScaleSpace.integral_dilL1E
statement:
theorem integral_dilL1E (A : E ≃L[ℝ] E) (f : E →₁[volume] ℝ) :
    ∫ x, (dilL1E A f : E → ℝ) x = ∫ x, (f : E → ℝ) x
proof:
:= by
  have hdet : 0 < |LinearMap.det (A : E →ₗ[ℝ] E)| := abs_pos.mpr (det_ne_zeroE A)
  rw [integral_congr_ae (coeFn_dilL1E A f)]
  simp only [dilateE]
  rw [integral_const_mul, ← integral_map A.symm.continuous.measurable.aemeasurable
      ((Lp.aestronglyMeasurable f).mono_ac
        (by rw [map_symm_volumeE]; exact Measure.smul_absolutelyContinuous)),
    map_symm_volumeE, integral_smul_measure, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hdet.le, smul_eq_mul,
    ← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hdet.ne', one_mul]

name: ScaleSpace.coeFn_dilL1E_of_abs_det_eq_one
statement:
theorem coeFn_dilL1E_of_abs_det_eq_one (Q : E ≃L[ℝ] E)
    (hQ : |LinearMap.det (Q : E →ₗ[ℝ] E)| = 1) (f : E →₁[volume] ℝ) :
    dilL1E Q f =ᵐ[volume] fun x => (f : E → ℝ) (Q.symm x)
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [coeFn_dilL1E Q f] with x hx
  rw [hx, dilateE_apply, hQ, inv_one, one_mul]

name: ScaleSpace.coeFn_dilL1E_homothety
statement:
theorem coeFn_dilL1E_homothety {lam : ℝ} (hlam : 0 < lam) (f : E →₁[volume] ℝ) :
    dilL1E (homothety lam hlam.ne') f =ᵐ[volume]
      fun x => (lam ^ Module.finrank ℝ E)⁻¹ * (f : E → ℝ) (lam⁻¹ • x)
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [coeFn_dilL1E (homothety lam hlam.ne') f] with x hx
  rw [hx, dilateE_apply, det_homothety, abs_of_pos (pow_pos hlam _), homothety_symm_apply]

name: ScaleSpace.measurePreserving_negE
statement: theorem measurePreserving_negE : MeasurePreserving (fun x : E => -x) volume volume
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨measurable_neg, ?_⟩
  have h := map_symm_volumeE (ContinuousLinearEquiv.neg ℝ : E ≃L[ℝ] E)
  rw [abs_det_neg, ENNReal.ofReal_one, one_smul] at h
  exact h

name: ScaleSpace.reflect_congr_aeE
statement:
theorem reflect_congr_aeE {f g : E → ℝ} (h : f =ᵐ[volume] g) :
    (fun x => f (-x)) =ᵐ[volume] fun x => g (-x)
proof:
:=
  measurePreserving_negE.quasiMeasurePreserving.ae h

name: ScaleSpace.integrable_reflectE
statement:
theorem integrable_reflectE {f : E → ℝ} (hf : Integrable f) :
    Integrable (fun x => f (-x))
proof:
:=
  (measurePreserving_negE.integrable_comp hf.aestronglyMeasurable).mpr hf

name: ScaleSpace.coeFn_reflL1E
statement:
lemma coeFn_reflL1E (f : E →₁[volume] ℝ) :
    reflL1E f =ᵐ[volume] fun x => (f : E → ℝ) (-x)
proof:
:=
  Integrable.coeFn_toL1 (integrable_reflectE (L1.integrable_coeFn f))

name: ScaleSpace.reflL1E_eq_dilL1E
statement:
theorem reflL1E_eq_dilL1E :
    (reflL1E : (E →₁[volume] ℝ) →L[ℝ] (E →₁[volume] ℝ)) = dilL1E (ContinuousLinearEquiv.neg ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun f => Lp.ext ?_
  refine (coeFn_reflL1E f).trans ?_
  refine Filter.EventuallyEq.symm ((coeFn_dilL1E_of_abs_det_eq_one _ abs_det_neg f).trans ?_)
  filter_upwards with x
  rfl

name: ScaleSpace.mconvE_apply
statement:
lemma mconvE_apply (μ : Measure E) (f : E → ℝ) (x : E) :
    mconvE μ f x = ∫ y, f (x - y) ∂μ
proof: := rfl

name: ScaleSpace.lintegral_lintegral_sub_eqE
proof:
:= by
  have huncurry : AEMeasurable (Function.uncurry fun x y : E => g (x - y)) (volume.prod μ) :=
    hg.comp_quasiMeasurePreserving (quasiMeasurePreserving_sub volume μ)
  calc ∫⁻ x, (∫⁻ y, g (x - y) ∂μ)
      = ∫⁻ y, (∫⁻ x, g (x - y) ∂volume) ∂μ := lintegral_lintegral_swap huncurry
    _ = ∫⁻ _, (∫⁻ x, g x) ∂μ := lintegral_congr fun y => lintegral_sub_right_eq_self _ y
    _ = μ univ * ∫⁻ x, g x := by rw [lintegral_const, mul_comm]

name: ScaleSpace.lintegral_enorm_mconv_leE
proof:
:= by
  calc ∫⁻ x, ‖mconvE μ f x‖ₑ ≤ ∫⁻ x, (∫⁻ y, ‖f (x - y)‖ₑ ∂μ) :=
        lintegral_mono fun x => enorm_integral_le_lintegral_enorm _
    _ = μ univ * ∫⁻ x, ‖f x‖ₑ := lintegral_lintegral_sub_eqE μ hf.enorm

name: ScaleSpace.integrable_uncurry_subE
proof:
:= by
  have hm : AEStronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry fun x y : E => f (x - y)) (volume.prod μ) :=
    hf.comp_quasiMeasurePreserving (quasiMeasurePreserving_sub volume μ)
  refine ⟨hm, ?_⟩
  have hprod : ∫⁻ p, ‖Function.uncurry (fun x y : E => f (x - y)) p‖ₑ ∂(volume.prod μ)
      = ∫⁻ x, (∫⁻ y, ‖f (x - y)‖ₑ ∂μ) := lintegral_prod _ hm.enorm
  rw [hasFiniteIntegral_iff_enorm, hprod, lintegral_lintegral_sub_eqE μ hf.enorm]
  exact ENNReal.mul_lt_top (measure_lt_top μ univ) hfi.2

name: ScaleSpace.integrable_mconvE
statement:
theorem integrable_mconvE (μ : Measure E) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {f : E → ℝ}
    (hf : AEStronglyMeasurable f) (hfi : Integrable f) : Integrable (mconvE μ f)
proof:
:=
  (integrable_uncurry_subE μ hf hfi).integral_prod_left

name: ScaleSpace.ae_ae_sub_of_aeE
statement:
theorem ae_ae_sub_of_aeE (μ : Measure E) [SFinite μ] {p : E → Prop} (h : ∀ᵐ u ∂volume, p u) :
    ∀ᵐ x ∂volume, ∀ᵐ y ∂μ, p (x - y)
proof:
:=
  Measure.ae_ae_of_ae_prod ((quasiMeasurePreserving_sub volume μ).ae h)

name: ScaleSpace.mconvE_congr_ae
statement:
theorem mconvE_congr_ae (μ : Measure E) [SFinite μ] {f g : E → ℝ} (h : f =ᵐ[volume] g) :
    mconvE μ f =ᵐ[volume] mconvE μ g
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [ae_ae_sub_of_aeE μ h] with x hx
  exact integral_congr_ae hx

name: ScaleSpace.mconvE_add_ae
statement:
theorem mconvE_add_ae (μ : Measure E) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {f g : E → ℝ}
    (hf : AEStronglyMeasurable f) (hfi : Integrable f)
    (hg : AEStronglyMeasurable g) (hgi : Integrable g) :
    mconvE μ (f + g) =ᵐ[volume] mconvE μ f + mconvE μ g
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [(integrable_uncurry_subE μ hf hfi).prod_right_ae,
    (integrable_uncurry_subE μ hg hgi).prod_right_ae] with x h1 h2
  simp only [Function.uncurry] at h1 h2
  simp only [mconvE_apply, Pi.add_apply]
  exact integral_add h1 h2

name: ScaleSpace.mconvE_smul
statement:
theorem mconvE_smul (μ : Measure E) (c : ℝ) (f : E → ℝ) :
    mconvE μ (c • f) = c • mconvE μ f
proof:
:= by
  funext x
  simp only [mconvE_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, integral_const_mul]

name: ScaleSpace.coeFn_mconvL1E
statement:
lemma coeFn_mconvL1E (μ : Measure E) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (f : E →₁[volume] ℝ) :
    mconvL1E μ f =ᵐ[volume] mconvE μ (f : E → ℝ)
proof:
:=
  Integrable.coeFn_toL1 (integrable_mconvE μ (Lp.aestronglyMeasurable f) (L1.integrable_coeFn f))

name: ScaleSpace.eq_mconvL1E_iff
statement:
theorem eq_mconvL1E_iff (μ : Measure E) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (Φ : (E →₁[volume] ℝ) →L[ℝ] (E →₁[volume] ℝ)) :
    Φ = mconvL1E μ ↔ ∀ f : E →₁[volume] ℝ, (Φ f : E → ℝ) =ᵐ[volume] mconvE μ (f : E → ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro rfl f
    exact coeFn_mconvL1E μ f
  · intro h
    exact ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun f => Lp.ext ((h f).trans (coeFn_mconvL1E μ f).symm)

name: ScaleSpace.mconvE_comp_sub
statement:
theorem mconvE_comp_sub (μ : Measure E) (f : E → ℝ) (a : E) :
    mconvE μ (fun x => f (x - a)) = fun x => mconvE μ f (x - a)
proof:
:= by
  funext x
  simp only [mconvE_apply, sub_right_comm]

name: ScaleSpace.integral_mconvE
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mconvE_apply]
  rw [integral_integral_swap (integrable_uncurry_subE μ hf hfi)]
  simp_rw [integral_sub_right_eq_self]
  rw [integral_const, smul_eq_mul, measureReal_def]

name: ScaleSpace.mconvE_conv
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [(integrable_uncurry_subE (μ ∗ ν) hf hfi).prod_right_ae] with x hx
  simp only [Function.uncurry] at hx
  have hadd : AEMeasurable (fun p : E × E => p.1 + p.2) (μ.prod ν) :=
    (measurable_fst.add measurable_snd).aemeasurable
  have hprod : Integrable (fun p : E × E => f (x - (p.1 + p.2))) (μ.prod ν) := by
    rw [Measure.conv] at hx
    exact (integrable_map_measure hx.aestronglyMeasurable hadd).mp hx
  have hmap : ∫ u, f (x - u) ∂(μ ∗ ν) = ∫ p : E × E, f (x - (p.1 + p.2)) ∂(μ.prod ν) := by
    rw [Measure.conv]
    exact integral_map hadd (by rw [← Measure.conv]; exact hx.aestronglyMeasurable)
  simp only [mconvE_apply]
  rw [hmap, integral_prod_symm _ hprod]
  simp only [sub_add_eq_sub_sub, sub_right_comm]

name: ScaleSpace.mconvE_dirac_zero
statement: theorem mconvE_dirac_zero (f : E → ℝ) : mconvE (Measure.dirac 0) f = f
proof:
:= by
  funext x
  rw [mconvE_apply, integral_dirac, sub_zero]

name: ScaleSpace.mconvL1E_congr
statement:
theorem mconvL1E_congr {μ ν : Measure E} [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [IsFiniteMeasure ν] (h : μ = ν) :
    mconvL1E μ = mconvL1E ν
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  congr 1

name: ScaleSpace.norm_mconvL1E_le
statement:
theorem norm_mconvL1E_le (μ : Measure E) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (f : E →₁[volume] ℝ) :
    ‖mconvL1E μ f‖ ≤ ‖f‖
proof:
:= by
  have hop : ‖mconvL1E μ‖ ≤ 1 := by
    rw [mconvL1E]
    refine le_trans (LinearMap.mkContinuous_norm_le _ ENNReal.toReal_nonneg _) ?_
    rw [measure_univ, ENNReal.toReal_one]
  calc ‖mconvL1E μ f‖ ≤ ‖mconvL1E μ‖ * ‖f‖ := ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm _ _
    _ ≤ 1 * ‖f‖ := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg f]
    _ = ‖f‖ := one_mul _

name: ScaleSpace.mconvL1E_transL1E
statement:
theorem mconvL1E_transL1E (μ : Measure E) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (a : E) (f : E →₁[volume] ℝ) :
    mconvL1E μ (transL1E a f) = transL1E a (mconvL1E μ f)
proof:
:= by
  refine Lp.ext ?_
  refine (coeFn_mconvL1E μ (transL1E a f)).trans ?_
  refine (mconvE_congr_ae μ (coeFn_transL1E a f)).trans ?_
  rw [mconvE_comp_sub]
  refine Filter.EventuallyEq.symm ?_
  refine (coeFn_transL1E a (mconvL1E μ f)).trans ?_
  exact translate_congr_aeE a (coeFn_mconvL1E μ f)

name: ScaleSpace.isNonnegE_mconvL1E
statement:
theorem isNonnegE_mconvL1E (μ : Measure E) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {f : E →₁[volume] ℝ}
    (hf : IsNonnegE f) : IsNonnegE (mconvL1E μ f)
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [coeFn_mconvL1E μ f, ae_ae_sub_of_aeE μ hf] with x hcoe hx
  rw [Pi.zero_apply, hcoe, mconvE_apply]
  exact integral_nonneg_of_ae hx

name: ScaleSpace.integral_mconvL1E
statement:
theorem integral_mconvL1E (μ : Measure E) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (f : E →₁[volume] ℝ) :
    ∫ x, (mconvL1E μ f : E → ℝ) x = ∫ x, (f : E → ℝ) x
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_congr_ae (coeFn_mconvL1E μ f),
    integral_mconvE μ (Lp.aestronglyMeasurable f) (L1.integrable_coeFn f),
    measure_univ, ENNReal.toReal_one, one_mul]

name: ScaleSpace.mconvL1E_comp
statement:
theorem mconvL1E_comp (μ ν : Measure E) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [IsFiniteMeasure ν] :
    (mconvL1E ν).comp (mconvL1E μ) = mconvL1E (μ ∗ ν)
proof:
:= by
  refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun f => Lp.ext ?_
  refine ((coeFn_mconvL1E ν (mconvL1E μ f)).trans
    (mconvE_congr_ae ν (coeFn_mconvL1E μ f))).trans ?_
  refine Filter.EventuallyEq.trans ?_ (coeFn_mconvL1E (μ ∗ ν) f).symm
  exact mconvE_conv μ ν (Lp.aestronglyMeasurable f) (L1.integrable_coeFn f)

name: ScaleSpace.mconvL1E_dirac_zero
statement:
theorem mconvL1E_dirac_zero :
    mconvL1E (Measure.dirac (0 : E)) = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (E →₁[volume] ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun f => Lp.ext ?_
  refine (coeFn_mconvL1E _ f).trans ?_
  rw [mconvE_dirac_zero]
  rfl

name: ScaleSpace.dilateE_mconvE
statement:
theorem dilateE_mconvE (A : E ≃L[ℝ] E) (μ : Measure E) {f : E → ℝ} (hf : Measurable f) :
    dilateE A (mconvE μ f) = mconvE (μ.map A) (dilateE A f)
proof:
:= by
  have hmeas : Measurable (dilateE A f) :=
    (hf.comp A.symm.continuous.measurable).const_mul _
  funext x
  have hcomp : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun y : E => dilateE A f (x - y)) (μ.map A) :=
    (hmeas.comp (measurable_const.sub measurable_id)).aestronglyMeasurable
  rw [mconvE_apply, integral_map A.continuous.measurable.aemeasurable hcomp]
  simp only [dilateE_apply, mconvE_apply, map_sub, ContinuousLinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  rw [integral_const_mul]

name: ScaleSpace.dilL1E_comp_mconvL1E
statement:
theorem dilL1E_comp_mconvL1E (A : E ≃L[ℝ] E) (μ : Measure E) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    [IsFiniteMeasure (μ.map A)] :
    (dilL1E A).comp (mconvL1E μ) = (mconvL1E (μ.map A)).comp (dilL1E A)
proof:
:= by
  refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun f => Lp.ext ?_
  set g := (Lp.aestronglyMeasurable f).mk (f : E → ℝ) with hg_def
  have hgm : Measurable g := (Lp.aestronglyMeasurable f).stronglyMeasurable_mk.measurable
  have hfg : (f : E → ℝ) =ᵐ[volume] g := (Lp.aestronglyMeasurable f).ae_eq_mk
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply]
  have h1 : (dilL1E A (mconvL1E μ f) : E → ℝ)
      =ᵐ[volume] mconvE (μ.map A) (dilateE A (f : E → ℝ)) := by
    refine (coeFn_dilL1E A (mconvL1E μ f)).trans ?_
    refine (dilateE_congr_ae A (coeFn_mconvL1E μ f)).trans ?_
    refine (dilateE_congr_ae A (mconvE_congr_ae μ hfg)).trans ?_
    rw [dilateE_mconvE A μ hgm]
    exact mconvE_congr_ae _ (dilateE_congr_ae A hfg.symm)
  have h2 : (mconvL1E (μ.map A) (dilL1E A f) : E → ℝ)
      =ᵐ[volume] mconvE (μ.map A) (dilateE A (f : E → ℝ)) :=
    (coeFn_mconvL1E _ (dilL1E A f)).trans (mconvE_congr_ae _ (coeFn_dilL1E A f))
  exact h1.trans h2.symm

name: ScaleSpace.dilL1E_conj_mconvL1E
statement:
theorem dilL1E_conj_mconvL1E (A : E ≃L[ℝ] E) (μ ν : Measure E) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    [IsFiniteMeasure ν] (h : μ.map A = ν) :
    ((dilL1E A).comp (mconvL1E μ)).comp (dilL1E A.symm) = mconvL1E ν
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsFiniteMeasure (μ.map A) := h ▸ inferInstance
  rw [dilL1E_comp_mconvL1E, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_assoc, dilL1E_comp_symm,
    ContinuousLinearMap.comp_id]
  exact mconvL1E_congr h

name: ScaleSpace.intertwines_iff_dilL1E
statement:
theorem intertwines_iff_dilL1E (c : ℝ) (hc : c ≠ 0) (A : E ≃L[ℝ] E)
    (Φ Ψ : (E →₁[volume] ℝ) →L[ℝ] (E →₁[volume] ℝ)) :
    (∀ f g : E →₁[volume] ℝ, ((g : E → ℝ) =ᵐ[volume] fun x => c * (f : E → ℝ) (A.symm x)) →
      ((Ψ g : E → ℝ) =ᵐ[volume] fun x => c * (Φ f : E → ℝ) (A.symm x))) ↔
    Ψ.comp (dilL1E A) = (dilL1E A).comp Φ
proof:
:= by
  set k := c * |LinearMap.det (A : E →ₗ[ℝ] E)| with hk
  have hdet : |LinearMap.det (A : E →ₗ[ℝ] E)| ≠ 0 := abs_ne_zero.mpr (det_ne_zeroE A)
  have hk0 : k ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero hc hdet
  
  have hrep : ∀ h : E →₁[volume] ℝ,
      ((k • dilL1E A h : E →₁[volume] ℝ) : E → ℝ) =ᵐ[volume]
        fun x => c * (h : E → ℝ) (A.symm x) := by
    intro h
    filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_smul k (dilL1E A h), coeFn_dilL1E A h] with x h1 h2
    rw [h1, Pi.smul_apply, h2, dilateE_apply, smul_eq_mul, hk]
    field_simp
  constructor
  · intro H
    refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun f => ?_
    have := H f (k • dilL1E A f) (hrep f)
    have h2 : Ψ (k • dilL1E A f) = k • dilL1E A (Φ f) :=
      Lp.ext (this.trans (hrep (Φ f)).symm)
    rw [map_smul] at h2
    simpa [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply] using smul_right_injective _ hk0 h2
  · intro H f g hg
    have hg' : g = k • dilL1E A f := Lp.ext (hg.trans (hrep f).symm)
    have : Ψ g = k • dilL1E A (Φ f) := by
      rw [hg', map_smul]
      congr 1
      exact congrArg (fun L : (E →₁[volume] ℝ) →L[ℝ] (E →₁[volume] ℝ) => L f) H
    rw [this]
    exact hrep (Φ f)

name: ScaleSpace.translation_iff_transL1E
statement:
theorem translation_iff_transL1E (Φ : (E →₁[volume] ℝ) →L[ℝ] (E →₁[volume] ℝ)) :
    (∀ (a : E) (f g : E →₁[volume] ℝ), ((g : E → ℝ) =ᵐ[volume] fun x => (f : E → ℝ) (x - a)) →
      ((Φ g : E → ℝ) =ᵐ[volume] fun x => (Φ f : E → ℝ) (x - a))) ↔
    ∀ a : E, Φ.comp (transL1E a) = (transL1E a).comp Φ
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro H a
    refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun f => ?_
    exact (eq_transL1E_iff a (Φ f) _).mpr (H a f _ (coeFn_transL1E a f))
  · intro H a f g hg
    rw [(eq_transL1E_iff a f g).mpr hg]
    have := congrArg (fun L : (E →₁[volume] ℝ) →L[ℝ] (E →₁[volume] ℝ) => L f) (H a)
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply] at this
    rw [this]
    exact coeFn_transL1E a (Φ f)

name: ScaleSpace.transL1E_real
statement: theorem transL1E_real (a : ℝ) : transL1E a = transL1 a
proof:
:=
  ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun f => Lp.ext ((coeFn_transL1E a f).trans (coeFn_transL1 a f).symm)

name: ScaleSpace.reflL1E_real
statement: theorem reflL1E_real : (reflL1E : X →L[ℝ] X) = reflL1
proof:
:=
  ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun f => Lp.ext ((coeFn_reflL1E f).trans (coeFn_reflL1 f).symm)

name: ScaleSpace.mconvL1E_real
statement: theorem mconvL1E_real (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] : mconvL1E μ = mconvL1 μ
proof:
:=
  ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun f => Lp.ext ((coeFn_mconvL1E μ f).trans (coeFn_mconvL1 μ f).symm)

name: ScaleSpace.mconvE_real
statement: theorem mconvE_real (μ : Measure ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) : mconvE μ f = mconv μ f
proof: := rfl

name: ScaleSpace.dilateE_homothety_real
statement:
theorem dilateE_homothety_real {lam : ℝ} (hlam : 0 < lam) (f : ℝ → ℝ) :
    dilateE (homothety lam hlam.ne') f = dilate lam f
proof:
:= by
  funext x
  rw [dilateE_apply, det_homothety, Module.finrank_self, pow_one, abs_of_pos hlam,
    homothety_symm_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  rfl

name: ScaleSpace.dilL1E_homothety_real
statement:
theorem dilL1E_homothety_real {lam : ℝ} (hlam : 0 < lam) :
    dilL1E (homothety lam hlam.ne') = dilL1 hlam
proof:
:= by
  refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun f => Lp.ext ?_
  refine (coeFn_dilL1E _ f).trans ?_
  rw [dilateE_homothety_real hlam]
  exact (coeFn_dilL1 hlam f).symm

name: ScaleSpace.isNonnegE_real
statement: theorem isNonnegE_real (f : X) : IsNonnegE f ↔ IsNonneg f
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: ScaleSpace.continuous_transDiffE
statement: theorem continuous_transDiffE (f : E →₁[volume] ℝ) : Continuous (transDiffE f)
proof:
:=
  ((continuous_transL1E f).sub continuous_const).norm

name: ScaleSpace.transDiffE_nonneg
statement: theorem transDiffE_nonneg (f : E →₁[volume] ℝ) (y : E) : 0 ≤ transDiffE f y
proof: := norm_nonneg _

name: ScaleSpace.transDiffE_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem transDiffE_zero (f : E →₁[volume] ℝ) : transDiffE f 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [transDiffE, transL1E_zero, ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply, sub_self, norm_zero]

name: ScaleSpace.transDiffE_le
statement: theorem transDiffE_le (f : E →₁[volume] ℝ) (y : E) : transDiffE f y ≤ 2 * ‖f‖
proof:
:= by
  calc transDiffE f y ≤ ‖transL1E y f‖ + ‖f‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
    _ ≤ 2 * ‖f‖ := by linarith [norm_transL1E_le y f]

name: ScaleSpace.integrable_transDiffE
statement:
theorem integrable_transDiffE (μ : Measure E) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (f : E →₁[volume] ℝ) :
    Integrable (transDiffE f) μ
proof:
:=
  (integrable_const (2 * ‖f‖)).mono' (continuous_transDiffE f).aestronglyMeasurable
    (Eventually.of_forall fun y => by
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (transDiffE_nonneg f y)]
      exact transDiffE_le f y)

name: ScaleSpace.norm_mconvL1E_sub_le
statement:
theorem norm_mconvL1E_sub_le (μ : Measure E) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (f : E →₁[volume] ℝ) :
    ‖mconvL1E μ f - f‖ ≤ ∫ y, transDiffE f y ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  have hsplit : mconvL1E μ f - f = ∫ y, (transL1E y f - f) ∂μ := by
    rw [integral_sub (integrable_transL1E μ f) (integrable_const f), integral_const,
      ← bconvME_eq_mconvL1E, bconvME, probReal_univ, one_smul]
  rw [hsplit]
  exact norm_integral_le_integral_norm _

name: ScaleSpace.transDiffE_mconvL1E_le
statement:
theorem transDiffE_mconvL1E_le (ν : Measure E) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (f : E →₁[volume] ℝ)
    (y : E) : transDiffE (mconvL1E ν f) y ≤ transDiffE f y
proof:
:= by
  have hcomm : transL1E y (mconvL1E ν f) - mconvL1E ν f = mconvL1E ν (transL1E y f - f) := by
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.map_sub, mconvL1E_transL1E]
  rw [transDiffE, transDiffE, hcomm]
  exact norm_mconvL1E_le ν _

name: ScaleSpace.norm_mconvL1E_comp_sub_le
statement:
theorem norm_mconvL1E_comp_sub_le (μ ν : Measure E) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (f : E →₁[volume] ℝ) :
    ‖mconvL1E μ (mconvL1E ν f) - mconvL1E ν f‖ ≤ ∫ y, transDiffE f y ∂μ
proof:
:=
  (norm_mconvL1E_sub_le μ (mconvL1E ν f)).trans
    (integral_mono (integrable_transDiffE μ _) (integrable_transDiffE μ f)
      (transDiffE_mconvL1E_le ν f))

name: ScaleSpace.transDiffBCFE_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem transDiffBCFE_apply (f : E →₁[volume] ℝ) (y : E) :
    transDiffBCFE f y = transDiffE f y
proof: := rfl

name: ScaleSpace.transDiffE_real
statement: theorem transDiffE_real (f : X) (y : ℝ) : transDiffE f y = transDiff f y
proof:
:= by
  rw [transDiffE, transDiff, transL1E_real]

name: ScaleSpace.tendsto_integral_transDiffE_of_tendsto_charFun
statement:
theorem tendsto_integral_transDiffE_of_tendsto_charFun {μ : ℕ → Measure E}
    [hμ : ∀ n, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ n)]
    (h : ∀ ω, Tendsto (fun n => charFun (μ n) ω) atTop (𝓝 1)) (f : E →₁[volume] ℝ) :
    Tendsto (fun n => ∫ y, transDiffE f y ∂(μ n)) atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  set P : ℕ → ProbabilityMeasure E := fun n => ⟨μ n, hμ n⟩ with hP
  set P₀ : ProbabilityMeasure E := ⟨Measure.dirac 0, inferInstance⟩ with hP₀
  have hconv : Tendsto P atTop (𝓝 P₀) := by
    refine ProbabilityMeasure.tendsto_of_tendsto_charFun fun ω => ?_
    have h0 : charFun (P₀ : Measure E) ω = 1 := by
      change charFun (Measure.dirac (0 : E)) ω = 1
      rw [charFun_dirac]
      simp
    rw [h0]
    exact h ω
  have := ProbabilityMeasure.tendsto_iff_forall_integral_tendsto.mp hconv (transDiffBCFE f)
  simpa [hP, hP₀] using this

name: ScaleSpace.tendsto_norm_mconvL1E_sub_of_tendsto_charFun
statement:
theorem tendsto_norm_mconvL1E_sub_of_tendsto_charFun {μ : ℕ → Measure E}
    [∀ n, IsProbabilityMeasure (μ n)]
    (h : ∀ ω, Tendsto (fun n => charFun (μ n) ω) atTop (𝓝 1)) (f : E →₁[volume] ℝ) :
    Tendsto (fun n => ‖mconvL1E (μ n) f - f‖) atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:=
  squeeze_zero (fun _ => norm_nonneg _) (fun n => norm_mconvL1E_sub_le (μ n) f)
    (tendsto_integral_transDiffE_of_tendsto_charFun h f)

name: ScaleSpace.cin_apply
statement: lemma cin_apply (z : ℝ) : cin z = ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..z, cinIntegrand v
proof: := rfl

name: ScaleSpace.cinIntegrand_nonneg
statement: theorem cinIntegrand_nonneg {v : ℝ} (hv : 0 ≤ v) : 0 ≤ cinIntegrand v
proof:
:=
  div_nonneg (by linarith [Real.cos_le_one v]) hv

name: ScaleSpace.cinIntegrand_neg
statement: theorem cinIntegrand_neg (v : ℝ) : cinIntegrand (-v) = -cinIntegrand v
proof:
:= by
  rw [cinIntegrand, cinIntegrand, Real.cos_neg, div_neg]

name: ScaleSpace.cinIntegrand_le_half
statement: theorem cinIntegrand_le_half {v : ℝ} (hv : 0 ≤ v) : cinIntegrand v ≤ v / 2
proof:
:= by
  rcases hv.eq_or_lt with rfl | hv'
  · simp [cinIntegrand]
  · rw [cinIntegrand, div_le_iff₀ hv']
    nlinarith [Real.one_sub_sq_div_two_le_cos (x := v)]

name: ScaleSpace.measurable_cinIntegrand
statement: theorem measurable_cinIntegrand : Measurable cinIntegrand
proof:
:= by
  unfold cinIntegrand; fun_prop

name: ScaleSpace.intervalIntegrable_cinIntegrand
statement:
theorem intervalIntegrable_cinIntegrand {z : ℝ} (hz : 0 ≤ z) :
    IntervalIntegrable cinIntegrand volume 0 z
proof:
:= by
  rw [intervalIntegrable_iff_integrableOn_Ioc_of_le hz]
  have hfin : volume (Ioc (0 : ℝ) z) ≠ ⊤ := by
    rw [Real.volume_Ioc]; exact ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top
  refine Integrable.mono' (g := fun _ : ℝ => z / 2) (integrableOn_const (hs := hfin))
    measurable_cinIntegrand.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
  refine (ae_restrict_iff' measurableSet_Ioc).mpr (.of_forall fun v hv => ?_)
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (cinIntegrand_nonneg hv.1.le)]
  exact le_trans (cinIntegrand_le_half hv.1.le) (by linarith [hv.2])

name: ScaleSpace.abs_cinIntegrand_le
statement: theorem abs_cinIntegrand_le (v : ℝ) : |cinIntegrand v| ≤ |v| / 2
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_or_gt 0 v with hv | hv
  · rw [abs_of_nonneg (cinIntegrand_nonneg hv), abs_of_nonneg hv]
    exact cinIntegrand_le_half hv
  · have h := cinIntegrand_le_half (v := -v) (by linarith)
    have h0 := cinIntegrand_nonneg (v := -v) (by linarith)
    have hneg := cinIntegrand_neg v
    rw [abs_of_nonpos (by linarith), abs_of_neg hv]
    linarith

name: ScaleSpace.continuous_cinIntegrand
statement: theorem continuous_cinIntegrand : Continuous cinIntegrand
proof:
:= by
  rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
  intro v
  rcases eq_or_ne v 0 with rfl | hv
  · rw [ContinuousAt, show cinIntegrand 0 = 0 by simp [cinIntegrand]]
    refine squeeze_zero_norm (a := fun w : ℝ => |w| / 2) (fun w => ?_) ?_
    · rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
      exact abs_cinIntegrand_le w
    · have hc : Continuous fun w : ℝ => |w| / 2 := by fun_prop
      simpa using (hc.tendsto 0)
  · unfold cinIntegrand
    exact ContinuousAt.div (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop) hv

name: ScaleSpace.hasDerivAt_cin
statement: theorem hasDerivAt_cin (z : ℝ) : HasDerivAt cin (cinIntegrand z) z
proof:
:=
  intervalIntegral.integral_hasDerivAt_right
    (continuous_cinIntegrand.intervalIntegrable 0 z)
    (continuous_cinIntegrand.stronglyMeasurableAtFilter _ _)
    continuous_cinIntegrand.continuousAt

name: ScaleSpace.continuous_cin
statement: theorem continuous_cin : Continuous cin
proof:
:=
  continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr fun z => ((hasDerivAt_cin z).differentiableAt).continuousAt

name: ScaleSpace.cin_zero
statement: theorem cin_zero : cin 0 = 0
proof: := by simp [cin]

name: ScaleSpace.cin_neg
statement: theorem cin_neg (z : ℝ) : cin (-z) = cin z
proof:
:= by
  have h : (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..z, cinIntegrand (-x)) = ∫ x in (-z)..(-0:ℝ), cinIntegrand x :=
    intervalIntegral.integral_comp_neg cinIntegrand
  have hl : (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..z, cinIntegrand (-x)) = -cin z := by
    simp only [cinIntegrand_neg, intervalIntegral.integral_neg, cin_apply]
  have hr : (∫ x in (-z)..(-0:ℝ), cinIntegrand x) = -cin (-z) := by
    rw [neg_zero, intervalIntegral.integral_symm, cin_apply]
  rw [hl, hr] at h
  exact (neg_injective h).symm

name: ScaleSpace.cin_nonneg
statement: theorem cin_nonneg {z : ℝ} (hz : 0 ≤ z) : 0 ≤ cin z
proof:
:= by
  rw [cin_apply]
  refine intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg hz fun v hv => cinIntegrand_nonneg hv.1

name: ScaleSpace.cin_le_sq_of_nonneg
statement: theorem cin_le_sq_of_nonneg {z : ℝ} (hz : 0 ≤ z) : cin z ≤ z ^ 2 / 4
proof:
:= by
  have hmono : (∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..z, cinIntegrand v) ≤ ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..z, v / 2 :=
    intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on hz (intervalIntegrable_cinIntegrand hz)
        ((by fun_prop : Continuous fun v : ℝ => v / 2).intervalIntegrable 0 z)
      fun v hv => cinIntegrand_le_half hv.1
  have hval : (∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..z, v / 2) = z ^ 2 / 4 := by
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_div, integral_id]; ring
  rw [cin_apply, ← hval]
  exact hmono

name: ScaleSpace.cin_le_sq
statement: theorem cin_le_sq (z : ℝ) : cin z ≤ z ^ 2 / 4
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_or_gt 0 z with hz | hz
  · exact cin_le_sq_of_nonneg hz
  · rw [← cin_neg]
    simpa using cin_le_sq_of_nonneg (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ -z)

name: ScaleSpace.monotoneOn_cin
statement: theorem monotoneOn_cin : MonotoneOn cin (Ici 0)
proof:
:= by
  intro a ha b hb hab
  have ha' : (0 : ℝ) ≤ a := ha
  have hb' : (0 : ℝ) ≤ b := hb
  have hsplit : cin a + (∫ v in a..b, cinIntegrand v) = cin b := by
    rw [cin_apply, cin_apply]
    exact intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals
      ((intervalIntegrable_cinIntegrand hb').mono_set (by
        rw [Set.uIcc_of_le ha', Set.uIcc_of_le hb']; exact Icc_subset_Icc le_rfl hab))
      ((intervalIntegrable_cinIntegrand hb').mono_set (by
        rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hab, Set.uIcc_of_le hb']; exact Icc_subset_Icc ha' le_rfl))
  have hnn : 0 ≤ ∫ v in a..b, cinIntegrand v :=
    intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg hab fun v hv => cinIntegrand_nonneg (le_trans ha' hv.1)
  linarith

name: ScaleSpace.cin_elementary
statement:
theorem cin_elementary :
    (∀ z : ℝ, cin (-z) = cin z) ∧ MonotoneOn cin (Ici 0) ∧ ∀ z : ℝ, cin z ≤ z ^ 2 / 4
proof:
:=
  ⟨cin_neg, monotoneOn_cin, cin_le_sq⟩

name: ScaleSpace.cin_sub_sq_bound
statement:
theorem cin_sub_sq_bound {z : ℝ} (hz : 0 ≤ z) (hz1 : z ≤ 1) :
    |cin z - z ^ 2 / 4| ≤ 5 / 96 * z ^ 4
proof:
:= by
  have hval : (∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..z, v / 2) = z ^ 2 / 4 := by
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_div, integral_id]; ring
  have hsub : cin z - z ^ 2 / 4 = ∫ v in (0 : ℝ)..z, (cinIntegrand v - v / 2) := by
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub (intervalIntegrable_cinIntegrand hz)
      ((by fun_prop : Continuous fun v : ℝ => v / 2).intervalIntegrable 0 z), cin_apply, hval]
  have hbound : ∀ v ∈ Set.uIoc (0 : ℝ) z, ‖cinIntegrand v - v / 2‖ ≤ 5 / 96 * z ^ 3 := by
    intro v hv
    rw [Set.uIoc_of_le hz] at hv
    obtain ⟨hv0, hvz⟩ := hv
    have hv1 : |v| ≤ 1 := by rw [abs_of_pos hv0]; linarith
    have hcb := Real.cos_bound hv1
    rw [abs_of_pos hv0] at hcb
    have hkey : cinIntegrand v - v / 2 = -((Real.cos v - (1 - v ^ 2 / 2)) / v) := by
      rw [cinIntegrand]; field_simp; ring
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, hkey, abs_neg, abs_div, abs_of_pos hv0, div_le_iff₀ hv0]
    calc |Real.cos v - (1 - v ^ 2 / 2)| ≤ v ^ 4 * (5 / 96) := hcb
      _ ≤ 5 / 96 * z ^ 3 * v := by nlinarith [pow_le_pow_left₀ hv0.le hvz 3, sq_nonneg v, hv0.le]
  have hres := intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const hbound
  rw [← hsub, Real.norm_eq_abs] at hres
  calc |cin z - z ^ 2 / 4| ≤ 5 / 96 * z ^ 3 * |z - 0| := hres
    _ = 5 / 96 * z ^ 4 := by rw [sub_zero, abs_of_nonneg hz]; ring

name: ScaleSpace.cin_expansion_zero_bound
statement:
theorem cin_expansion_zero_bound {z : ℝ} (hz1 : |z| ≤ 1) :
    |cin z - z ^ 2 / 4| ≤ 5 / 96 * z ^ 4
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_or_gt 0 z with hz | hz
  · exact cin_sub_sq_bound hz (by rwa [abs_of_nonneg hz] at hz1)
  · have h := cin_sub_sq_bound (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ -z)
      (by rw [abs_of_neg hz] at hz1; exact hz1)
    rw [cin_neg] at h
    calc |cin z - z ^ 2 / 4| = |cin z - (-z) ^ 2 / 4| := by ring_nf
      _ ≤ 5 / 96 * (-z) ^ 4 := h
      _ = 5 / 96 * z ^ 4 := by ring

name: ScaleSpace.cin_expansion_zero
statement:
theorem cin_expansion_zero :
    (fun z : ℝ => cin z - z ^ 2 / 4) =O[𝓝 0] fun z : ℝ => z ^ 4
proof:
:= by
  refine Asymptotics.isBigO_iff.mpr ⟨5 / 96, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [Metric.closedBall_mem_nhds (0 : ℝ) one_pos] with z hz
  have hz1 : |z| ≤ 1 := by simpa [Real.dist_eq] using hz
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ z ^ 4)]
  exact cin_expansion_zero_bound hz1

name: ScaleSpace.rpow_neg_two
statement: theorem rpow_neg_two {v : ℝ} (hv : 0 < v) : v ^ (-2 : ℝ) = (v ^ 2)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Real.rpow_natCast v 2, ← Real.rpow_neg hv.le]
  norm_num

name: ScaleSpace.integrableOn_sin_div_sq
statement:
theorem integrableOn_sin_div_sq {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    IntegrableOn (fun v : ℝ => Real.sin v / v ^ 2) (Ioi c)
proof:
:= by
  have hg : IntegrableOn (fun v : ℝ => v ^ (-2 : ℝ)) (Ioi c) :=
    integrableOn_Ioi_rpow_of_lt (by norm_num) hc
  refine Integrable.mono' hg
    ((Real.measurable_sin.div (measurable_id.pow_const 2)).aestronglyMeasurable) ?_
  filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi] with v hv
  have hv0 : 0 < v := lt_trans hc hv
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_div, abs_of_pos (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < v ^ 2), rpow_neg_two hv0,
    div_le_iff₀ (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < v ^ 2)]
  have := Real.abs_sin_le_one v
  rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ (by positivity : (v:ℝ) ^ 2 ≠ 0)]
  exact this

name: ScaleSpace.norm_integral_Ioi_sin_div_sq
statement:
theorem norm_integral_Ioi_sin_div_sq {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    ‖∫ v in Ioi c, Real.sin v / v ^ 2‖ ≤ c⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hg : IntegrableOn (fun v : ℝ => v ^ (-2 : ℝ)) (Ioi c) :=
    integrableOn_Ioi_rpow_of_lt (by norm_num) hc
  have hval : (∫ v in Ioi c, v ^ (-2 : ℝ)) = c⁻¹ := by
    rw [integral_Ioi_rpow_of_lt (by norm_num) hc]
    rw [show (-2 : ℝ) + 1 = -1 by norm_num, show (-1 : ℝ) = -(1 : ℝ) by norm_num,
      Real.rpow_neg hc.le, Real.rpow_one]
    ring
  calc ‖∫ v in Ioi c, Real.sin v / v ^ 2‖
      ≤ ∫ v in Ioi c, ‖Real.sin v / v ^ 2‖ := norm_integral_le_integral_norm _
    _ ≤ ∫ v in Ioi c, v ^ (-2 : ℝ) := by
        refine setIntegral_mono_on (integrableOn_sin_div_sq hc).norm hg measurableSet_Ioi ?_
        intro v hv
        have hv0 : 0 < v := lt_trans hc hv
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_div, abs_of_pos (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < v ^ 2),
          rpow_neg_two hv0, div_le_iff₀ (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < v ^ 2),
          inv_mul_cancel₀ (by positivity : (v:ℝ) ^ 2 ≠ 0)]
        exact Real.abs_sin_le_one v
    _ = c⁻¹ := hval

name: ScaleSpace.hasDerivAt_sin_div
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_sin_div {v : ℝ} (hv : v ≠ 0) :
    HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => Real.sin u / u) (Real.cos v / v - Real.sin v / v ^ 2) v
proof:
:= by
  have h : HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => Real.sin u / u)
      ((Real.cos v * v - Real.sin v * 1) / v ^ 2) v :=
    (Real.hasDerivAt_sin v).div (hasDerivAt_id' (x := v)) hv
  have heq : (Real.cos v * v - Real.sin v * 1) / v ^ 2
      = Real.cos v / v - Real.sin v / v ^ 2 := by field_simp
  rwa [heq] at h

name: ScaleSpace.integral_cos_div
statement:
theorem integral_cos_div {z : ℝ} (hz : 1 ≤ z) :
    (∫ v in (1 : ℝ)..z, Real.cos v / v)
      = Real.sin z / z - Real.sin 1 + ∫ v in (1 : ℝ)..z, Real.sin v / v ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hne : ∀ x ∈ uIcc (1 : ℝ) z, x ≠ 0 := by
    intro x hx
    rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hz] at hx
    exact ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hx.1)
  have hi1 : IntervalIntegrable (fun x : ℝ => Real.cos x / x) volume 1 z :=
    (ContinuousOn.div Real.continuous_cos.continuousOn continuousOn_id hne).intervalIntegrable
  have hi2 : IntervalIntegrable (fun x : ℝ => Real.sin x / x ^ 2) volume 1 z :=
    (ContinuousOn.div Real.continuous_sin.continuousOn
      (continuousOn_id.pow 2) fun x hx => pow_ne_zero 2 (hne x hx)).intervalIntegrable
  have hftc := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt
    (f := fun u : ℝ => Real.sin u / u)
    (f' := fun x : ℝ => Real.cos x / x - Real.sin x / x ^ 2)
    (fun x hx => hasDerivAt_sin_div (hne x hx)) (hi1.sub hi2)
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub hi1 hi2] at hftc
  linarith [hftc]

name: ScaleSpace.cin_eq_log_sub
statement:
theorem cin_eq_log_sub {z : ℝ} (hz : 1 ≤ z) :
    cin z = cin 1 + Real.log z - ∫ v in (1 : ℝ)..z, Real.cos v / v
proof:
:= by
  have hz0 : (0 : ℝ) < z := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hz
  have hne : ∀ x ∈ uIcc (1 : ℝ) z, x ≠ 0 := by
    intro x hx
    rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hz] at hx
    exact ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hx.1)
  have hi0 : IntervalIntegrable (fun x : ℝ => x⁻¹) volume 1 z :=
    (continuousOn_id.inv₀ hne).intervalIntegrable
  have hi1 : IntervalIntegrable (fun x : ℝ => Real.cos x / x) volume 1 z :=
    (ContinuousOn.div Real.continuous_cos.continuousOn continuousOn_id hne).intervalIntegrable
  have hcongr : (∫ v in (1 : ℝ)..z, cinIntegrand v) = ∫ v in (1 : ℝ)..z, (v⁻¹ - Real.cos v / v) := by
    refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr fun v hv => ?_
    have : v ≠ 0 := hne v hv
    rw [cinIntegrand]
    field_simp
  have hsplit : (∫ v in (1 : ℝ)..z, cinIntegrand v) = Real.log z - ∫ v in (1 : ℝ)..z, Real.cos v / v := by
    rw [hcongr, intervalIntegral.integral_sub hi0 hi1, integral_inv_of_pos zero_lt_one hz0,
      div_one]
  have hadd : cin 1 + (∫ v in (1 : ℝ)..z, cinIntegrand v) = cin z := by
    rw [cin_apply, cin_apply]
    exact intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals
      (intervalIntegrable_cinIntegrand zero_le_one)
      ((intervalIntegrable_cinIntegrand hz0.le).mono_set (by
        rw [Set.uIcc_of_le hz, Set.uIcc_of_le hz0.le]
        exact Icc_subset_Icc zero_le_one le_rfl))
  rw [← hadd, hsplit]
  ring

name: ScaleSpace.cin_sub_log_eq
statement:
theorem cin_sub_log_eq {z : ℝ} (hz : 1 ≤ z) :
    cin z - Real.log z - cinConst
      = -(Real.sin z / z) + ∫ v in Ioi z, Real.sin v / v ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hz0 : (0 : ℝ) < z := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hz
  have hsplit : (∫ v in Ioi (1 : ℝ), Real.sin v / v ^ 2)
      = (∫ v in (1 : ℝ)..z, Real.sin v / v ^ 2) + ∫ v in Ioi z, Real.sin v / v ^ 2 := by
    rw [← Set.Ioc_union_Ioi_eq_Ioi hz,
      setIntegral_union (Set.Ioc_disjoint_Ioi le_rfl) measurableSet_Ioi
        ((integrableOn_sin_div_sq zero_lt_one).mono_set Ioc_subset_Ioi_self)
        (integrableOn_sin_div_sq hz0),
      intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hz]
  rw [cin_eq_log_sub hz, integral_cos_div hz, cinConst, hsplit]
  ring

name: ScaleSpace.cin_expansion_top_bound
statement:
theorem cin_expansion_top_bound {z : ℝ} (hz : 1 ≤ z) :
    |cin z - Real.log z - cinConst| ≤ 2 * z⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hz0 : (0 : ℝ) < z := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hz
  rw [cin_sub_log_eq hz]
  have h1 : |Real.sin z / z| ≤ z⁻¹ := by
    rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hz0, div_le_iff₀ hz0, inv_mul_cancel₀ hz0.ne']
    exact Real.abs_sin_le_one z
  have h2 : |∫ v in Ioi z, Real.sin v / v ^ 2| ≤ z⁻¹ := by
    simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using norm_integral_Ioi_sin_div_sq hz0
  calc |-(Real.sin z / z) + ∫ v in Ioi z, Real.sin v / v ^ 2|
      ≤ |-(Real.sin z / z)| + |∫ v in Ioi z, Real.sin v / v ^ 2| := abs_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ z⁻¹ + z⁻¹ := by rw [abs_neg]; linarith
    _ = 2 * z⁻¹ := by ring

name: ScaleSpace.cin_expansion_top
statement:
theorem cin_expansion_top :
    ∃ C : ℝ, (fun z : ℝ => cin z - Real.log z - C) =O[atTop] fun z : ℝ => z⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨cinConst, Asymptotics.isBigO_iff.mpr ⟨2, ?_⟩⟩
  filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop (1 : ℝ)] with z hz
  have hz0 : (0 : ℝ) < z := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hz
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < z⁻¹)]
  exact cin_expansion_top_bound hz

name: ScaleSpace.cin_nonneg'
statement: theorem cin_nonneg' (z : ℝ) : 0 ≤ cin z
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_or_gt 0 z with hz | hz
  · exact cin_nonneg hz
  · rw [← cin_neg]; exact cin_nonneg (by linarith)

name: ScaleSpace.dilate_cinIntegrand
statement:
theorem dilate_cinIntegrand (ω x : ℝ) :
    (1 - Real.cos (ω * x)) / x = ω * cinIntegrand (ω * x)
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne ω 0 with rfl | hω
  · simp [cinIntegrand]
  rcases eq_or_ne x 0 with rfl | hx
  · simp [cinIntegrand]
  · rw [cinIntegrand]; field_simp

name: ScaleSpace.intervalIntegral_dilate_cinIntegrand
statement:
theorem intervalIntegral_dilate_cinIntegrand (ω z : ℝ) :
    (∫ x in (0 : ℝ)..z, (1 - Real.cos (ω * x)) / x) = cin (ω * z)
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne ω 0 with rfl | hω
  · simp [cin, cinIntegrand]
  · simp only [dilate_cinIntegrand]
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, intervalIntegral.integral_comp_mul_left _ hω,
      mul_zero, smul_eq_mul, ← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hω, one_mul, cin]

name: ScaleSpace.dilate_cinIntegrand_nonneg
statement:
theorem dilate_cinIntegrand_nonneg (ω : ℝ) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    0 ≤ (1 - Real.cos (ω * x)) / x
proof:
:=
  div_nonneg (by linarith [Real.cos_le_one (ω * x)]) hx

name: ScaleSpace.dilate_cinIntegrand_le
statement:
theorem dilate_cinIntegrand_le (ω : ℝ) {x z : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hxz : x ≤ z) :
    (1 - Real.cos (ω * x)) / x ≤ ω ^ 2 * z / 2
proof:
:= by
  rcases hx.eq_or_lt with rfl | hx'
  · simp; positivity
  · rw [div_le_iff₀ hx']
    nlinarith [Real.one_sub_sq_div_two_le_cos (x := ω * x), sq_nonneg (ω * x), hx'.le, sq_nonneg ω]

name: ScaleSpace.intervalIntegrable_dilate_cinIntegrand
statement:
theorem intervalIntegrable_dilate_cinIntegrand (ω : ℝ) {z : ℝ} (hz : 0 ≤ z) :
    IntervalIntegrable (fun x : ℝ => (1 - Real.cos (ω * x)) / x) volume 0 z
proof:
:= by
  rw [intervalIntegrable_iff_integrableOn_Ioc_of_le hz]
  have hfin : volume (Ioc (0 : ℝ) z) ≠ ⊤ := by
    rw [Real.volume_Ioc]; exact ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top
  refine Integrable.mono' (g := fun _ : ℝ => ω ^ 2 * z / 2) (integrableOn_const (hs := hfin))
    (((measurable_const.sub (Real.measurable_cos.comp (measurable_const.mul measurable_id))).div
      measurable_id).aestronglyMeasurable) ?_
  refine (ae_restrict_iff' measurableSet_Ioc).mpr (.of_forall fun x hx => ?_)
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (dilate_cinIntegrand_nonneg ω hx.1.le)]
  exact dilate_cinIntegrand_le ω hx.1.le hx.2

name: ScaleSpace.Phi_eq_mconvL1
statement:
theorem Phi_eq_mconvL1 (hker : IsKernelFamily Fam.Φ μ) {s t : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hst : s ≤ t)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure (μ s t)] : Fam.Φ s t = mconvL1 (μ s t)
proof:
:=
  eq_mconvL1_of_ae (hker.conv s t hs hst)

name: ScaleSpace.isSymmetric_kernel
statement:
theorem isSymmetric_kernel (hker : IsKernelFamily Fam.Φ μ) {s t : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hst : s ≤ t)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure (μ s t)] : IsSymmetric (μ s t)
proof:
:=
  isSymmetric_of_reflL1 (Phi_eq_mconvL1 hker hs hst) (Fam.reflection s t hs hst)

name: ScaleSpace.kernel_conv
statement:
theorem kernel_conv (hker : IsKernelFamily Fam.Φ μ) {r s t : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hrs : r ≤ s)
    (hst : s ≤ t) : μ r t = μ r s ∗ μ s t
proof:
:= by
  haveI := hker.isProbability r s hr hrs
  haveI := hker.isProbability s t (hr.trans hrs) hst
  haveI := hker.isProbability r t hr (hrs.trans hst)
  refine mconvL1_injective ?_
  rw [← Phi_eq_mconvL1 hker hr (hrs.trans hst), ← mconvL1_comp,
    ← Phi_eq_mconvL1 hker hr hrs, ← Phi_eq_mconvL1 hker (hr.trans hrs) hst,
    Fam.cascade r s t hr hrs hst]

name: ScaleSpace.kernel_diag
statement:
theorem kernel_diag (hker : IsKernelFamily Fam.Φ μ) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    μ t t = Measure.dirac 0
proof:
:= by
  haveI := hker.isProbability t t ht le_rfl
  refine mconvL1_injective ?_
  rw [← Phi_eq_mconvL1 hker ht le_rfl, Fam.diag t ht, mconvL1_dirac_zero]

name: ScaleSpace.fourierCos_kernel_mul
statement:
theorem fourierCos_kernel_mul (hker : IsKernelFamily Fam.Φ μ) {r s t : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (hrs : r ≤ s) (hst : s ≤ t) (ω : ℝ) :
    fourierCos (μ r t) ω = fourierCos (μ r s) ω * fourierCos (μ s t) ω
proof:
:= by
  haveI := hker.isProbability r s hr hrs
  haveI := hker.isProbability s t (hr.trans hrs) hst
  haveI := hker.isProbability r t hr (hrs.trans hst)
  have hcx : ((fourierCos (μ r t) ω : ℝ) : ℂ)
      = ((fourierCos (μ r s) ω : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((fourierCos (μ s t) ω : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    rw [← charFun_eq_fourierCos_of_symmetric (isSymmetric_kernel hker hr hrs),
      ← charFun_eq_fourierCos_of_symmetric (isSymmetric_kernel hker (hr.trans hrs) hst),
      ← charFun_eq_fourierCos_of_symmetric (isSymmetric_kernel hker hr (hrs.trans hst)),
      kernel_conv hker hr hrs hst, charFun_conv]
  exact_mod_cast hcx

name: ScaleSpace.continuousOn_fourierCos_kernel
proof:
:= by
  set S : Set (ℝ × ℝ) := {p : ℝ × ℝ | 0 ≤ p.1 ∧ p.1 ≤ p.2} with hS
  have hA7 : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => Fam.Φ p.1 p.2 gaussL1) S := Fam.continuous gaussL1
  have hpair : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => charCLM ω (Fam.Φ p.1 p.2 gaussL1)) S :=
    (charCLM ω).continuous.comp_continuousOn hA7
  have hval : ∀ p ∈ S, ((fourierCos (μ p.1 p.2) ω : ℝ) : ℂ) * charCLM ω gaussL1
      = charCLM ω (Fam.Φ p.1 p.2 gaussL1) := by
    rintro p ⟨hp1, hp2⟩
    haveI := hker.isProbability p.1 p.2 hp1 hp2
    rw [Phi_eq_mconvL1 hker hp1 hp2, charCLM_mconvL1,
      charFun_eq_fourierCos_of_symmetric (isSymmetric_kernel hker hp1 hp2)]
  have hprod : ContinuousOn
      (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => ((fourierCos (μ p.1 p.2) ω : ℝ) : ℂ) * charCLM ω gaussL1) S :=
    hpair.congr hval
  have hcpx : ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => ((fourierCos (μ p.1 p.2) ω : ℝ) : ℂ)) S := by
    have hne := charCLM_gaussL1_ne_zero ω
    refine (hprod.div_const (charCLM ω gaussL1)).congr fun p _ => ?_
    show ((fourierCos (μ p.1 p.2) ω : ℝ) : ℂ)
        = ((fourierCos (μ p.1 p.2) ω : ℝ) : ℂ) * charCLM ω gaussL1 / charCLM ω gaussL1
    rw [mul_div_assoc, div_self hne, mul_one]
  exact Complex.continuous_re.comp_continuousOn hcpx

name: ScaleSpace.nonvanishing
statement:
theorem nonvanishing (Fam : PreCascadeCore) (μ : ℝ → ℝ → Measure ℝ)
    (hker : IsKernelFamily Fam.Φ μ) {s t : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hst : s ≤ t) (ω : ℝ) :
    0 < fourierCos (μ s t) ω
proof:
:= by
  set G : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := fun p => fourierCos (μ p.1 p.2) ω with hG
  
  set K : Set (ℝ × ℝ) := {p : ℝ × ℝ | s ≤ p.1 ∧ p.1 ≤ p.2 ∧ p.2 ≤ t} with hK
  have hKclosed : IsClosed K := by
    have h1 : IsClosed {p : ℝ × ℝ | s ≤ p.1} := isClosed_le continuous_const continuous_fst
    have h2 : IsClosed {p : ℝ × ℝ | p.1 ≤ p.2} := isClosed_le continuous_fst continuous_snd
    have h3 : IsClosed {p : ℝ × ℝ | p.2 ≤ t} := isClosed_le continuous_snd continuous_const
    have : K = {p : ℝ × ℝ | s ≤ p.1} ∩ ({p : ℝ × ℝ | p.1 ≤ p.2} ∩ {p : ℝ × ℝ | p.2 ≤ t}) := by
      ext p; simp [hK]
    rw [this]
    exact h1.inter (h2.inter h3)
  have hKsub : K ⊆ Icc s t ×ˢ Icc s t := by
    rintro p ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩
    exact ⟨⟨h1, h2.trans h3⟩, ⟨h1.trans h2, h3⟩⟩
  have hKcompact : IsCompact K :=
    IsCompact.of_isClosed_subset (isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc) hKclosed hKsub
  have hKS : K ⊆ {p : ℝ × ℝ | 0 ≤ p.1 ∧ p.1 ≤ p.2} := by
    rintro p ⟨h1, h2, _⟩
    exact ⟨hs.trans h1, h2⟩
  have hGK : ContinuousOn G K := (continuousOn_fourierCos_kernel hker ω).mono hKS
  
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hunif⟩ := Metric.uniformContinuousOn_iff.mp
    (hKcompact.uniformContinuousOn_of_continuous hGK) (1 / 2) (by norm_num)
  have hdiag : ∀ a : ℝ, 0 ≤ a → G (a, a) = 1 := by
    intro a ha
    simp only [hG, kernel_diag hker ha, fourierCos_dirac_zero]
  have hstep : ∀ a b : ℝ, s ≤ a → a ≤ b → b ≤ t → b - a < δ → 0 < G (a, b) := by
    intro a b ha hab hbt hlt
    have hmemab : (a, b) ∈ K := ⟨ha, hab, hbt⟩
    have hmemaa : (a, a) ∈ K := ⟨ha, le_rfl, hab.trans hbt⟩
    have hdist : dist ((a, b) : ℝ × ℝ) (a, a) < δ := by
      rw [Prod.dist_eq]
      simp only [dist_self, Real.dist_eq, max_lt_iff]
      exact ⟨hδ, by rw [abs_of_nonneg (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ b - a)]; exact hlt⟩
    have := hunif _ hmemab _ hmemaa hdist
    rw [hdiag a (hs.trans ha), Real.dist_eq] at this
    have := abs_lt.mp this
    linarith [this.1]
  
  set d : ℝ := δ / 2 with hd
  have hdpos : 0 < d := by positivity
  set r : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => min (s + n * d) t with hr
  have hrs : ∀ n, s ≤ r n := by
    intro n
    refine le_min ?_ hst
    nlinarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) n, hdpos]
  have hrt : ∀ n, r n ≤ t := fun n => min_le_right _ _
  have hrmono : ∀ n, r n ≤ r (n + 1) := by
    intro n
    refine min_le_min ?_ le_rfl
    push_cast
    nlinarith [hdpos]
  have hrdiff : ∀ n, r (n + 1) - r n < δ := by
    intro n
    rcases le_total (s + n * d) t with h | h
    · have h1 : r n = s + n * d := min_eq_left h
      have h2 : r (n + 1) ≤ s + ((n : ℝ) + 1) * d := by
        rw [hr]
        push_cast
        exact min_le_left _ _
      rw [h1]
      nlinarith [hdpos]
    · have h1 : r n = t := min_eq_right h
      have h2 : r (n + 1) = t := by
        refine min_eq_right (le_trans h ?_)
        push_cast
        nlinarith [hdpos]
      rw [h1, h2]
      simpa using hδ
  have hind : ∀ n, 0 < fourierCos (μ s (r n)) ω := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
        have h0 : r 0 = s := by simp [hr, min_eq_left hst]
        rw [h0, kernel_diag hker hs, fourierCos_dirac_zero]
        norm_num
    | succ n ih =>
        rw [fourierCos_kernel_mul hker hs (hrs n) (hrmono n) ω]
        exact mul_pos ih (hstep (r n) (r (n + 1)) (hrs n) (hrmono n) (hrt (n + 1)) (hrdiff n))
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_nat_ge ((t - s) / d)
  have hreach : r n = t := by
    refine min_eq_right ?_
    have := (div_le_iff₀ hdpos).mp hn
    linarith
  rw [← hreach]
  exact hind n

name: ScaleSpace.one_sub_exp_neg_le
statement: theorem one_sub_exp_neg_le (u : ℝ) : 1 - Real.exp (-u) ≤ u
proof:
:= by
  have h := Real.add_one_le_exp (-u)
  linarith

name: ScaleSpace.sub_one_sub_exp_neg_le
statement:
theorem sub_one_sub_exp_neg_le (u : ℝ) (hu : 0 ≤ u) :
    u - (1 - Real.exp (-u)) ≤ u ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (0:ℝ) < 1 + u := by linarith
  have h2 : Real.exp u ≥ 1 + u := by
    have := Real.add_one_le_exp u
    linarith
  have h3 : Real.exp (-u) ≤ (1 + u)⁻¹ := by
    rw [Real.exp_neg]
    exact inv_anti₀ h1 h2
  have h4 : (1 + u)⁻¹ ≤ 1 - u + u ^ 2 := by
    rw [inv_le_iff_one_le_mul₀ h1]
    nlinarith [pow_nonneg hu 3]
  linarith

name: ScaleSpace.sub_sin_eq_intervalIntegral
statement:
lemma sub_sin_eq_intervalIntegral (u : ℝ) :
    u - Real.sin u = ∫ v in (0:ℝ)..u, (1 - Real.cos v)
proof:
:= by
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub intervalIntegrable_const
    (intervalIntegral.intervalIntegrable_cos)]
  simp

name: ScaleSpace.one_sub_sinc_ge_of_le_pi
statement:
lemma one_sub_sinc_ge_of_le_pi {u : ℝ} (hu : 0 < u) (hπ : u ≤ Real.pi) :
    2 / (3 * Real.pi ^ 2) * u ^ 2 ≤ 1 - Real.sinc u
proof:
:= by
  have hπ0 : (0:ℝ) < Real.pi := Real.pi_pos
  have hlow : (2 / Real.pi ^ 2) * (u ^ 3 / 3) ≤ u - Real.sin u := by
    rw [sub_sin_eq_intervalIntegral u]
    have hmono : ∫ v in (0:ℝ)..u, (2 / Real.pi ^ 2) * v ^ 2
        ≤ ∫ v in (0:ℝ)..u, (1 - Real.cos v) := by
      refine intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on hu.le
        ((intervalIntegral.intervalIntegrable_pow 2).const_mul _)
        (IntervalIntegrable.sub intervalIntegrable_const
          intervalIntegral.intervalIntegrable_cos) fun v hv => ?_
      have habs : |v| ≤ Real.pi := by
        rw [abs_of_nonneg hv.1]
        exact le_trans hv.2 hπ
      have := Real.cos_le_one_sub_mul_cos_sq habs
      linarith
    refine le_trans (le_of_eq ?_) hmono
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, integral_pow]
    ring
  have hsinc : Real.sinc u = Real.sin u / u := Real.sinc_of_ne_zero hu.ne'
  have hpine : Real.pi ≠ 0 := hπ0.ne'
  have hstep : 1 - Real.sin u / u = (u - Real.sin u) / u := by field_simp
  rw [hsinc, hstep, le_div_iff₀ hu]
  have hcalc : 2 / (3 * Real.pi ^ 2) * u ^ 2 * u = 2 / Real.pi ^ 2 * (u ^ 3 / 3) := by
    field_simp
  rw [hcalc]
  exact hlow

name: ScaleSpace.one_sub_sinc_ge
statement:
theorem one_sub_sinc_ge (u : ℝ) :
    2 / (3 * Real.pi ^ 2) * min 1 (u ^ 2) ≤ 1 - Real.sinc u
proof:
:= by
  have hπ0 : (0:ℝ) < Real.pi := Real.pi_pos
  have hc : (0:ℝ) < 2 / (3 * Real.pi ^ 2) := by positivity
  
  have key : ∀ v : ℝ, 0 ≤ v → 2 / (3 * Real.pi ^ 2) * min 1 (v ^ 2) ≤ 1 - Real.sinc v := by
    intro v hv
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hv with h | hv0
    · rw [← h]
      simp
    rcases le_or_gt v Real.pi with hle | hgt
    · refine le_trans ?_ (one_sub_sinc_ge_of_le_pi hv0 hle)
      have : min 1 (v ^ 2) ≤ v ^ 2 := min_le_right _ _
      nlinarith
    · 
      have hA : 2 / (3 * Real.pi ^ 2) * min 1 (v ^ 2) ≤ 2 / (3 * Real.pi ^ 2) := by
        nlinarith [min_le_left (1:ℝ) (v ^ 2), hc.le]
      have h27 : (3:ℝ) < 3 * Real.pi ^ 2 := by nlinarith [Real.pi_gt_three, Real.pi_pos]
      have hB : 2 / (3 * Real.pi ^ 2) < 2 / 3 :=
        div_lt_div_of_pos_left (by norm_num) (by norm_num) h27
      have hC : (2:ℝ) / 3 ≤ 1 - Real.sinc v := by
        have h1 : Real.sinc v ≤ v⁻¹ := by
          have h := Real.sinc_le_inv_abs hv0.ne'
          rwa [abs_of_pos hv0] at h
        have h3 : v⁻¹ ≤ (3:ℝ)⁻¹ := by
          refine inv_anti₀ (by norm_num) ?_
          linarith [Real.pi_gt_three]
        norm_num at h3 ⊢
        linarith
      linarith
  rcases le_or_gt 0 u with h | h
  · exact key u h
  · have hneg : (0:ℝ) ≤ -u := by linarith
    simpa using key (-u) hneg

name: ScaleSpace.cinProfile_nonneg
statement: theorem cinProfile_nonneg (τ : ℝ) (x : ℝ) : 0 ≤ cinProfile τ x
proof:
:= by
  rw [cinProfile]
  by_cases hx : x ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) τ <;> simp [hx]

name: ScaleSpace.cinProfile_le_one
statement: theorem cinProfile_le_one (τ : ℝ) (x : ℝ) : cinProfile τ x ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [cinProfile]
  by_cases hx : x ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) τ <;> simp [hx]

name: ScaleSpace.cinProfile_eq_zero
statement: theorem cinProfile_eq_zero {τ x : ℝ} (hx : x ∉ Ioo (0 : ℝ) τ) : cinProfile τ x = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [cinProfile, hx]

name: ScaleSpace.cinProfile_eq_one
statement: theorem cinProfile_eq_one {τ x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) τ) : cinProfile τ x = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [cinProfile, hx]

name: ScaleSpace.antitoneOn_cinProfile
statement: theorem antitoneOn_cinProfile (τ : ℝ) : AntitoneOn (cinProfile τ) (Ioi (0 : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  intro a ha b hb hab
  by_cases hb' : b ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) τ
  · rw [cinProfile_eq_one hb', cinProfile_eq_one ⟨ha, lt_of_le_of_lt hab hb'.2⟩]
  · rw [cinProfile_eq_zero hb']
    exact cinProfile_nonneg τ a

name: ScaleSpace.measurable_cinProfile
statement: theorem measurable_cinProfile (τ : ℝ) : Measurable (cinProfile τ)
proof:
:=
  (measurable_const.indicator measurableSet_Ioo)

name: ScaleSpace.cinSDProfile_exponentL
statement:
theorem cinSDProfile_exponentL {τ : ℝ} (hτ : 0 < τ) (ω : ℝ) :
    (cinSDProfile τ).exponentL ω = ENNReal.ofReal (cin (τ * ω))
proof:
:= by
  have hzero : (∫⁻ x in Ici τ,
      ENNReal.ofReal ((1 - Real.cos (ω * x)) * cinProfile τ x / x)) = 0 := by
    refine setLIntegral_eq_zero measurableSet_Ici fun x hx => ?_
    rw [cinProfile_eq_zero (by simp only [mem_Ioo, not_and, not_lt]; exact fun _ => hx),
      mul_zero, zero_div, ENNReal.ofReal_zero]
    rfl
  have hdisj : Disjoint (Ioo (0 : ℝ) τ) (Ici τ) := by
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    rintro x ⟨-, hx2⟩ hx3
    exact absurd (mem_Ici.mp hx3) (not_le.mpr hx2)
  have hsplit : (∫⁻ x in Ioi (0 : ℝ),
        ENNReal.ofReal ((1 - Real.cos (ω * x)) * cinProfile τ x / x))
      = ∫⁻ x in Ioo (0 : ℝ) τ, ENNReal.ofReal ((1 - Real.cos (ω * x)) / x) := by
    rw [← Ioo_union_Ici_eq_Ioi hτ, lintegral_union measurableSet_Ici hdisj, hzero, add_zero]
    refine setLIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioo fun x hx => ?_
    rw [cinProfile_eq_one hx, mul_one]
  have hint : IntegrableOn (fun x : ℝ => (1 - Real.cos (ω * x)) / x) (Ioo (0 : ℝ) τ) := by
    have h := intervalIntegrable_dilate_cinIntegrand ω hτ.le
    rw [intervalIntegrable_iff_integrableOn_Ioc_of_le hτ.le] at h
    exact h.mono_set Ioo_subset_Ioc_self
  rw [SDProfile.exponentL, show (cinSDProfile τ).a = 0 from rfl,
    show (cinSDProfile τ).k = cinProfile τ from rfl, zero_mul, ENNReal.ofReal_zero, zero_add,
    hsplit, ← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hint
      ((ae_restrict_iff' measurableSet_Ioo).mpr
        (.of_forall fun x hx => dilate_cinIntegrand_nonneg ω hx.1.le))]
  congr 1
  rw [← integral_Ioc_eq_integral_Ioo, ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hτ.le,
    intervalIntegral_dilate_cinIntegrand, mul_comm]

name: ScaleSpace.cin_ray
statement:
theorem cin_ray {τ : ℝ} (hτ : 0 < τ) :
    ∃ Q : SDProfile, Q.a = 0 ∧ Q.k = cinProfile τ ∧ ∀ ω : ℝ, Q.exponent ω = cin (τ * ω)
proof:
:=
  ⟨cinSDProfile τ, rfl, rfl, fun ω => by
    rw [SDProfile.exponent, cinSDProfile_exponentL hτ ω,
      ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (cin_nonneg' _)]⟩

name: ScaleSpace.gaussTest_apply
statement:
lemma gaussTest_apply (ω : ℝ) :
    gaussTest ω = (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * Real.exp (-(ω ^ 2) / 2)
proof:
:= by
  simp [gaussTest, gaussianPDFReal]

name: ScaleSpace.gaussTest_pos
statement: lemma gaussTest_pos (x : ℝ) : 0 < gaussTest x
proof: := gaussianPDFReal_pos 0 1 x one_ne_zero

name: ScaleSpace.continuous_gaussTest
statement: lemma continuous_gaussTest : Continuous gaussTest
proof:
:= by
  have h : gaussTest = fun ω => (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * Real.exp (-(ω ^ 2) / 2) :=
    funext gaussTest_apply
  rw [h]
  fun_prop

name: ScaleSpace.integral_fourierCos_mul_gaussTest
statement:
theorem integral_fourierCos_mul_gaussTest (ν : Measure ℝ) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] :
    ∫ ω, fourierCos ν ω * gaussTest ω = ∫ x, Real.exp (-(x ^ 2) / 2) ∂ν
proof:
:= by
  have hmeas : AEStronglyMeasurable
      (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => Real.cos (p.1 * p.2) * gaussTest p.1) (volume.prod ν) := by
    refine AEStronglyMeasurable.mul ?_ ?_
    · exact (Real.continuous_cos.comp (continuous_fst.mul continuous_snd)).aestronglyMeasurable
    · exact (measurable_gaussTest.comp measurable_fst).aestronglyMeasurable
  have hint : Integrable (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => Real.cos (p.1 * p.2) * gaussTest p.1)
      (volume.prod ν) := by
    refine (integrable_gaussTest.comp_fst ν).mono' hmeas ?_
    filter_upwards with p
    rw [norm_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (gaussTest_pos p.1)]
    exact mul_le_of_le_one_left (gaussTest_pos p.1).le (Real.abs_cos_le_one _)
  calc ∫ ω, fourierCos ν ω * gaussTest ω
      = ∫ ω, ∫ x, Real.cos (ω * x) * gaussTest ω ∂ν := by
        refine integral_congr_ae (ae_of_all _ fun ω => ?_)
        dsimp only
        rw [fourierCos_apply, integral_mul_const]
    _ = ∫ x, ∫ ω, Real.cos (ω * x) * gaussTest ω ∂volume ∂ν := integral_integral_swap hint
    _ = ∫ x, Real.exp (-(x ^ 2) / 2) ∂ν := by
        refine integral_congr_ae (ae_of_all _ fun x => ?_)
        dsimp only
        have hcomm : (fun ω => Real.cos (ω * x) * gaussTest ω)
            = fun ω => Real.cos (x * ω) * gaussTest ω := by
